		<button
			ref={(element) => register(index, element)}
			type="button"
			tabIndex={focusable ? 0 : -1}
			aria-pressed={popped}
			aria-label={`Bubble ${index + 1} of ${count}`}
			data-bubble-index={index}
			data-state={popped ? "popped" : "inflated"}
			onClick={(event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
				// Pointer presses pop on pointer down; this is the keyboard and screen reader path.
				if (event.detail === 0) onActivate(index);
			}}
			onFocus={() => onFocusCell(index)}
			className="group/bubble relative aspect-square cursor-pointer rounded-full outline-none [-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent] focus-visible:z-10 data-[state=popped]:cursor-default"
		>
			<span
				data-part="flat"
				aria-hidden
				className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-[7%] overflow-hidden opacity-0 group-data-[state=popped]/bubble:opacity-100"
				style={{ ...flatStyle, borderRadius: outline }}
			>
				<span
					className="absolute inset-0 bg-size-[72px_72px] opacity-(--bubble-wrap-grain-a) mix-blend-overlay"
					style={{ backgroundImage: grain }}
				/>
				<span
					className="absolute inset-0 blur-[1px]"
					style={creases.facetStyle}
				/>
				<svg
					viewBox="0 0 100 100"
					className="absolute inset-0 size-full fill-none blur-[0.3px]"
					strokeLinecap="round"
					strokeLinejoin="round"
				>
					{/* Each fold is a lit ridge beside a shaded crease. */}
					<g
						transform="translate(-0.9 -0.9)"
						strokeWidth={2.4}
						style={{
							stroke:
								"rgb(255 255 255 / calc(var(--bubble-wrap-crease-light) * 0.6))",
						}}
					>
						<path d={creases.folds} />
					</g>
					<g
						strokeWidth={1}
						style={{
							stroke:
								"rgb(var(--bubble-wrap-ink) / var(--bubble-wrap-crease-a))",
						}}
					>
						<path d={creases.folds} />
					</g>
					<ellipse
						cx={creases.tear.cx}
						cy={creases.tear.cy}
						rx={2.6}
						ry={1.8}
						style={{
							fill: "rgb(var(--bubble-wrap-ink) / calc(var(--bubble-wrap-crease-a) * 0.8))",
						}}
					/>
				</svg>
			</span>
			<span
				data-part="dome"
				aria-hidden
				className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 rounded-full group-data-[state=popped]/bubble:opacity-0"
			>
				{/* The dome's shadow on the tray. The dome itself is clear, so only the
				    crescent outside it shows, and light focused through the air pools
				    on the tray inside it. */}
				<span className="mask-[radial-gradient(closest-side_at_44%_41%,transparent_76%,#000_120%)] absolute inset-[2%] translate-x-[6%] translate-y-[9%] rounded-full bg-[rgb(var(--bubble-wrap-ink)/var(--bubble-wrap-shadow-a))] blur-[5px]" />
				<span className="absolute top-[50%] left-[42%] h-[32%] w-[42%] -rotate-[38deg] rounded-[50%] bg-[radial-gradient(closest-side,rgb(255_255_255/var(--bubble-wrap-caustic-a)),rgb(255_255_255/0))] blur-[2px]" />
				{/* Where the film lifts off the sheet, catching the light. */}
				<span className="absolute -inset-[2%] rounded-full shadow-[-0.5px_-0.75px_1.5px_rgb(255_255_255/var(--bubble-wrap-foot-a))]" />
				<span className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full" style={domeBodyStyle} />
				{/* Light caught along the inside of the lower rim. */}
				<span className="absolute inset-[6%] rounded-full shadow-[inset_-1.5px_-2px_2px_-1px_rgb(255_255_255/var(--bubble-wrap-caustic-a))]" />
				{/* One crisp reflection of a window. */}
				<span className="absolute top-[16%] left-[23%] h-[13%] w-[28%] -rotate-[34deg] rounded-[50%] bg-[radial-gradient(closest-side,rgb(255_255_255/var(--bubble-wrap-spec-a))_58%,rgb(255_255_255/0))]" />
			</span>
			<span
				data-part="ring"
				aria-hidden
				className="pointer-events-none absolute -inset-[4%] rounded-full bg-[radial-gradient(closest-side,rgb(var(--bubble-wrap-ink)/0)_70%,rgb(var(--bubble-wrap-ink)/var(--bubble-wrap-wave-dark))_83%,rgb(255_255_255/var(--bubble-wrap-wave-light))_91%,rgb(255_255_255/0))] opacity-0"
			/>
			<span
				aria-hidden
				className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 rounded-full opacity-0 shadow-[0_0_0_2px_#fff,0_0_0_4px_#18181b] group-focus-visible/bubble:opacity-100"
			/>
		</button>
	);
});

export function BubbleWrap({
	rows = 5,
	columns = 6,
	defaultPopped,
	tint = "clear",
	onPop,
	onClear,
	autoReset = true,
	showCount = false,
	sound = true,
	haptics = true,
	className,
	style,
	ref,
	"aria-label": ariaLabel,
	"aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledBy,
	onKeyDown,
	...props
}: BubbleWrapProps) {
	const columnCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(columns) || 1);
	const rowCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rows) || 1);
	const count = columnCount * rowCount;

	const [initialPopped] = useState(() =>
		Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) =>
			Boolean(defaultPopped?.includes(index)),
		),
	);
	const [popped, setPopped] = useState(initialPopped);
	const [fitColumns, setFitColumns] = useState(columnCount);
	const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
	const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState("");

	const reducedMotion = useReducedMotion() ?? false;
	const { trigger: haptic } = useWebHaptics();
	// Sound stays on under reduced motion; only movement is reduced.
	const { toggle: playToggle } = useTiks({
		theme: CLEAR_SOUND,
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});

	const id = useId();
	const titleId = `${id}-title`;
	const countId = `${id}-count`;

	const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const gridRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const cellsRef = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
	const poppedRef = useRef<boolean[]>(initialPopped.slice());
	const clearedRef = useRef(initialPopped.every(Boolean));
	const lastPoppedRef = useRef(defaultPopped?.at(-1) ?? 0);
	const sweepRef = useRef<Sweep | null>(null);
	const animationsRef = useRef(new Map<number, AnimationPlaybackControls[]>());
	/** Bubbles whose re-inflate animation is still running. */
	const inflatingRef = useRef(new Set<number>());
	const resetTimerRef = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);
	const flourishTimerRef = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);
	const lastHapticAtRef = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
	const fitColumnsRef = useRef(fitColumns);

	// Event handlers and timers read the latest props through refs.
	const latest = useRef({
		onPop,
		onClear,
		autoReset,
		sound,
		haptics,
		reducedMotion,
	});
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		fitColumnsRef.current = fitColumns;
		latest.current = {
			onPop,
			onClear,
			autoReset,
			sound,
			haptics,
			reducedMotion,
		};
	});

	const silent = () =>
		typeof document !== "undefined" && document.visibilityState === "hidden";

	const commit = () => setPopped(poppedRef.current.slice());

	// A new size keeps each bubble's state by index; added bubbles start inflated.
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		const current = poppedRef.current;
		if (current.length === count) return;
		const next = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) =>
			Boolean(current[index]),
		);
		poppedRef.current = next;
		cellsRef.current.length = count;
		clearedRef.current = next.every(Boolean);
		setPopped(next.slice());
		setActiveIndex((index) => Math.min(index, count - 1));
	}, [count]);

	// Fewer columns fit on narrow sheets, so no bubble shrinks below MIN_CELL_PX.
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		const grid = gridRef.current;
		if (!grid) return;
		const update = () =>
			setFitColumns(columnsFor(grid.clientWidth, columnCount));
		update();
		const observer = new ResizeObserver(update);
		observer.observe(grid);
		return () => observer.disconnect();
	}, [columnCount]);

	useEffect(
		() => () => {
			window.clearTimeout(resetTimerRef.current);
			window.clearTimeout(flourishTimerRef.current);
			for (const controls of animationsRef.current.values()) {
				for (const control of controls) control.stop();
			}
		},
		[],
	);

	const parts = (index: number) => {
		const cell = cellsRef.current[index];
		if (!cell) return null;
		const dome = cell.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-part="dome"]');
		const flat = cell.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-part="flat"]');
		const ring = cell.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-part="ring"]');
		if (!dome || !flat || !ring) return null;
		return { dome, flat, ring };
	};

	const stopAnimations = (index: number) => {
		const controls = animationsRef.current.get(index);
		if (controls) for (const control of controls) control.stop();
		animationsRef.current.delete(index);
		inflatingRef.current.delete(index);
	};

	const animatePop = (index: number, delay: number) => {
		stopAnimations(index);
		const elements = parts(index);
		if (!elements) return;
		const { dome, flat, ring } = elements;
		if (latest.current.reducedMotion) {
			animationsRef.current.set(index, [
				animate(dome, { opacity: 0, scale: 1, rotate: 0 }, { duration: 0 }),
				animate(flat, { opacity: 1, scale: 1 }, { duration: 0 }),
				animate(ring, { opacity: 0 }, { duration: 0 }),
			]);
			return;
		}
		const jitter = hashUnit(index, 1) * 4;
		animationsRef.current.set(index, [
			// A quick squash with a little twist, then the dome gives way.
			animateHeld(
				dome,
				{
					scale: [null, 0.88, 0.8],
					rotate: [null, jitter, jitter * 1.5],
					// Explicit, since the popped state already hides the dome in CSS.
					opacity: [1, 1, 0],
				},
				{ duration: 0.12, times: [0, 0.55, 1], ease: [squashEase, giveEase] },
				delay,
			),
			// The slack film spreads out flat and stops dead.
			animateHeld(
				flat,
				{ opacity: [0, 0, 1], scale: [0.86, 0.86, 1] },
				{ duration: 0.2, times: [0, 0.3, 1], ease: ["linear", settleEase] },
				delay,
			),
			// A pressure wave runs out through the film from the burst.
			animateHeld(
				ring,
				{ opacity: [0, 1, 0], scale: [0.9, 1.08, 1.5] },
				{ duration: 0.34, times: [0, 0.12, 1], ease: ["easeOut", waveEase] },
				delay + 55,
			),
		]);
	};

	const animateInflate = (index: number, delay: number) => {
		stopAnimations(index);
		const elements = parts(index);
		if (!elements) return;
		const { dome, flat, ring } = elements;
		inflatingRef.current.add(index);
		const controls = latest.current.reducedMotion
			? [
					animate(flat, { opacity: 0, scale: 1 }, { duration: 0 }),
					animate(ring, { opacity: 0 }, { duration: 0 }),
					animate(
						dome,
						{ opacity: [0, 1], scale: 1, rotate: 0 },
						{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" },
					),
				]
			: [
					animate(ring, { opacity: 0 }, { duration: 0 }),
					animateHeld(
						flat,
						{ opacity: [1, 0], scale: [1, 0.94] },
						{ duration: 0.14, times: [0, 1], ease: ["easeOut"] },
						delay,
					),
					// Blooms back up past full, then settles dead still.
					animateHeld(
						dome,
						{
							opacity: [0, 1, 1, 1],
							scale: [0.72, 1.07, 0.99, 1],
							rotate: [0, 0, 0, 0],
						},
						{
							duration: 0.42,
							times: [0, 0.45, 0.75, 1],
							ease: [settleEase, "easeInOut", "easeOut"],
						},
						delay,
					),
				];
		animationsRef.current.set(index, controls);
		void controls[controls.length - 1]?.finished.then(() => {
			if (animationsRef.current.get(index) === controls) {
				inflatingRef.current.delete(index);
			}
		});
	};

	/** Ripple delay of each bubble, by grid distance from `origin`. */
	const rippleDelay = (index: number, origin: number) => {
		const cols = fitColumnsRef.current;
		const dx = (index % cols) - (origin % cols);
		const dy = Math.floor(index / cols) - Math.floor(origin / cols);
		return Math.min(Math.hypot(dx, dy) * RIPPLE_STEP_MS, RIPPLE_MAX_MS);
	};

	const announceAfter = (before: number, after: number) => {
		if (after === 0) setAnnouncement("All popped");
		else if (
			Math.floor((before - 1) / ANNOUNCE_EVERY) >
			Math.floor((after - 1) / ANNOUNCE_EVERY)
		) {
			setAnnouncement(`${after} ${after === 1 ? "bubble" : "bubbles"} left`);
		}
	};

	const scheduleAutoReset = (after: number) => {
		window.clearTimeout(resetTimerRef.current);
		if (!latest.current.autoReset) return;
		resetTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
			resetTimerRef.current = undefined;
			if (latest.current.autoReset) resetSheet(lastPoppedRef.current, true);
		}, after);
	};

	/**
	 * Pops `indices` in order. With `ripple`, each waits for its distance from
	 * the origin. `cue` plays sounds and haptics, for user input only.
	 */
	const pop = (
		indices: number[],
		{ cue, ripple }: { cue: boolean; ripple?: number },
	) => {
		const state = poppedRef.current;
		const delayOf = (index: number) =>
			ripple === undefined ? 0 : rippleDelay(index, ripple);
		const fresh = indices.filter((index) => index < count && !state[index]);
		if (!fresh.length) return;
		// Ripples pop, and schedule their sounds, nearest first.
		if (ripple !== undefined) fresh.sort((a, b) => delayOf(a) - delayOf(b));
		const before = state.filter((value) => !value).length;
		const {
			sound: soundOn,
			haptics: hapticsOn,
			onPop: handlePop,
		} = latest.current;
		const audio = cue && soundOn && !silent() ? getPopAudio() : null;
		let longest = 0;
		for (const index of fresh) {
			state[index] = true;
			const delay = delayOf(index);
			longest = Math.max(longest, delay);
			animatePop(index, delay);
			if (audio) playPop(audio, delay / 1000, ripple === undefined ? 1 : 0.7);
		}
		lastPoppedRef.current = fresh[fresh.length - 1] ?? 0;
		commit();
		for (const index of fresh) handlePop?.(index);

		const now = performance.now();
		if (
			cue &&
			hapticsOn &&
			!silent() &&
			now - lastHapticAtRef.current >= CUE_THROTTLE_MS
		) {
			lastHapticAtRef.current = now;
			void haptic("light");
		}

		const after = before - fresh.length;
		announceAfter(before, after);
		if (after > 0 || clearedRef.current) return;
		clearedRef.current = true;
		latest.current.onClear?.();
		if (cue && !silent()) {
			window.clearTimeout(flourishTimerRef.current);
			flourishTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
				if (latest.current.sound) playToggle(false);
				if (latest.current.haptics) void haptic("medium");
			}, longest + FLOURISH_DELAY_MS);
		}
		scheduleAutoReset(longest + AUTO_RESET_MS);
	};

	/** Re-inflates popped bubbles, and restarts any ripple still running. Silent. */
	const resetSheet = (origin: number, announce: boolean) => {
		window.clearTimeout(resetTimerRef.current);
		window.clearTimeout(flourishTimerRef.current);
		resetTimerRef.current = undefined;
		const state = poppedRef.current;
		const targets: number[] = [];
		for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
			if (state[index] || inflatingRef.current.has(index)) targets.push(index);
		}
		clearedRef.current = false;
		if (!targets.length) return;
		const wasPopped = state.some(Boolean);
		poppedRef.current = Array(count).fill(false);
		for (const index of targets)
			animateInflate(index, rippleDelay(index, origin));
		commit();
		if (announce && wasPopped) setAnnouncement("New sheet");
	};

	const popAll = (origin: number, cue: boolean) => {
		const all = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => index);
		pop(all, { cue, ripple: origin });
	};

	const resetRef = useRef(resetSheet);
	const popAllRef = useRef(popAll);
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		resetRef.current = resetSheet;
		popAllRef.current = popAll;
	});

	useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
		reset: () => resetRef.current(lastPoppedRef.current, true),
		popAll: () => popAllRef.current(0, false),
	}));

	// Turning autoReset on while the sheet is clear refills it after the pause.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (!autoReset) window.clearTimeout(resetTimerRef.current);
		else if (clearedRef.current && resetTimerRef.current === undefined) {
			resetTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
				resetTimerRef.current = undefined;
				resetRef.current(lastPoppedRef.current, true);
			}, AUTO_RESET_MS);
		}
	}, [autoReset]);

	const endSweep = () => {
		const sweep = sweepRef.current;
		if (!sweep) return;
		sweepRef.current = null;
		const grid = gridRef.current;
		if (grid?.hasPointerCapture(sweep.pointerId)) {
			grid.releasePointerCapture(sweep.pointerId);
		}
		if (rootRef.current) delete rootRef.current.dataset.sweeping;
	};

	// iOS can still scroll the page under a captured pointer; block it mid-sweep.
	useEffect(() => {
		const grid = gridRef.current;
		if (!grid) return;
		const onTouchMove = (event: TouchEvent) => {
			if (sweepRef.current) event.preventDefault();
		};
		grid.addEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove, { passive: false });
		return () => grid.removeEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove);
	}, []);

	const onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		// One finger sweeps; a second one, or a right click, is ignored.
		if (!event.isPrimary || sweepRef.current) return;
		if (event.pointerType === "mouse" && event.button !== 0) return;
		const grid = gridRef.current;
		if (!grid) return;
		const rect = grid.getBoundingClientRect();
		const centers: Sweep["centers"] = [];
		let radius = 0;
		for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
			const cell = cellsRef.current[index]?.getBoundingClientRect();
			if (!cell) {
				centers.push({ x: Number.NaN, y: Number.NaN });
				continue;
			}
			centers.push({
				x: cell.left + cell.width / 2 - rect.left,
				y: cell.top + cell.height / 2 - rect.top,
			});
			radius = Math.max(radius, (cell.width / 2) * HIT_REACH);
		}
		const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
		const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
		sweepRef.current = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x, y, centers, radius };
		grid.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		if (rootRef.current) rootRef.current.dataset.sweeping = "";
		// Create the audio context inside the gesture so the first pop can play.
		if (latest.current.sound) getPopAudio();
		// A press anywhere on a bubble's square pops it.
		const target = (event.target as Element).closest<HTMLElement>(
			"[data-bubble-index]",
		);
		const index = target ? Number(target.dataset.bubbleIndex) : -1;
		if (index >= 0) pop([index], { cue: true });
	};

	const onPointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const sweep = sweepRef.current;
		if (!sweep || event.pointerId !== sweep.pointerId) return;
		const grid = gridRef.current;
		const root = rootRef.current;
		if (!grid || !root) return;
		const rect = grid.getBoundingClientRect();
		const native = event.nativeEvent;
		const coalesced = native.getCoalescedEvents?.() ?? [];
		const points = coalesced.length ? coalesced : [native];
		const reach = sweep.radius * sweep.radius;
		const state = poppedRef.current;
		const hits: { index: number; at: number }[] = [];
		// Test each segment between pointer samples, so fast sweeps skip nothing.
		points.forEach((point, step) => {
			const x = point.clientX - rect.left;
			const y = point.clientY - rect.top;
			sweep.centers.forEach((center, index) => {
				if (state[index] || hits.some((hit) => hit.index === index)) return;
				const hit = segmentHit(sweep.x, sweep.y, x, y, center.x, center.y);
				if (hit.distance <= reach) hits.push({ index, at: step + hit.t });
			});
			sweep.x = x;
			sweep.y = y;
		});
		if (hits.length) {
			hits.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);
			pop(
				hits.map((hit) => hit.index),
				{ cue: true },
			);
		}
		// Leaving the sheet ends the sweep.
		const bounds = root.getBoundingClientRect();
		if (
			event.clientX < bounds.left ||
			event.clientX > bounds.right ||
			event.clientY < bounds.top ||
			event.clientY > bounds.bottom
		) {
			endSweep();
		}
	};

	const onPointerEnd = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (sweepRef.current?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		endSweep();
	};

	const focusCell = (index: number) => {
		const next = clamp(index, 0, count - 1);
		setActiveIndex(next);
		cellsRef.current[next]?.focus();
	};

	const onGridKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const target = (event.target as Element).closest<HTMLElement>(
			"[data-bubble-index]",
		);
		if (!target) return;
		const index = Number(target.dataset.bubbleIndex);
		const cols = fitColumnsRef.current;
		const moves: Record<string, number> = {
			ArrowRight: index + 1,
			ArrowLeft: index - 1,
			ArrowDown: index + cols < count ? index + cols : index,
			ArrowUp: index - cols >= 0 ? index - cols : index,
			Home: 0,
			End: count - 1,
		};
		const next = moves[event.key];
		if (next === undefined) return;
		event.preventDefault();
		focusCell(next);
	};

	const register = useRef(
		(index: number, element: HTMLButtonElement | null) => {
			cellsRef.current[index] = element;
		},
	).current;
	const activateRef = useRef((index: number) => {
		popRef.current([index], { cue: true });
	}).current;
	const popRef = useRef(pop);
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		popRef.current = pop;
	});
	const onFocusCell = useRef((index: number) => setActiveIndex(index)).current;

	const poppedCount = popped.slice(0, count).filter(Boolean).length;
	const labelledBy =
		ariaLabelledBy ??
		(ariaLabel ? undefined : showCount ? `${titleId} ${countId}` : titleId);

	return (
		<div
			ref={rootRef}
			role="group"
			aria-label={ariaLabel}
			aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
			data-slot="bubble-wrap"
			data-tint={tint}
			data-state={poppedCount === count ? "clear" : "idle"}
			onKeyDown={(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
				onKeyDown?.(event);
				if (!event.defaultPrevented) onGridKeyDown(event);
			}}
			style={
				{
					"--bubble-wrap-width": `${columnCount * MAX_CELL_PX + (columnCount - 1) * GAP_PX + PADDING_PX * 2 + 2}px`,
					...style,
				} as CSSProperties
			}
			className={cn(

scratch-card:
"use client";

import { useTiks } from "@rexa-developer/tiks/react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import {
	type ComponentProps,
	type KeyboardEvent,
	type PointerEvent,
	type ReactNode,
	type Ref,
	useEffect,
	useImperativeHandle,
	useLayoutEffect,
	useRef,
	useState,
} from "react";
import { useWebHaptics } from "web-haptics/react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** Columns and rows of the coverage grid; each cell is cleared at most once. */
const GRID_COLUMNS = 40;
const GRID_ROWS = 24;
/** Brush radius as a fraction of the card width, clamped to px limits. */
const BRUSH_FRACTION = 0.06;
const MIN_BRUSH_PX = 14;
const MAX_BRUSH_PX = 30;
/** Distance between brush dabs, as a fraction of the radius. */
const DAB_SPACING = 0.2;
/** A grid cell is cleared once a dab center passes this close, as a fraction of the radius. */
const CLEAR_REACH = 0.8;
/** Px scratched over foil between haptic ticks. */
const HAPTIC_STEP_PX = 44;
/** Minimum ms between haptic ticks. */
const CUE_THROTTLE_MS = 35;
/** Minimum ms between scratch sound grains. */
const GRAIN_INTERVAL_MS = 28;
/** Length of one scratch sound grain, in seconds. */
const GRAIN_SECONDS = 0.07;
/** Below this pointer speed, in px/ms, the scratch is silent. */
const SILENT_SPEED = 0.03;
/** A stroke still counts as scratching foil this many ms after it last cleared a cell. */
const FRESH_MS = 90;
/** Px scratched over foil per flake, and the most flakes alive at once. */
const FLAKE_STEP_PX = 9;
const MAX_FLAKES = 24;
/** Canvas backing store limit, in device px per CSS px. */
const MAX_BACKING_SCALE = 4;
/** Resting sheen position along the gradient, and how far the pointer moves it. */
const SHEEN_REST = 0.42;
const SHEEN_PARALLAX = 0.14;
const GRADIENT_ANGLE = 115;
const CORNER_RADIUS = 16;

const revealEase = [0.23, 1, 0.32, 1] as const;
const REVEAL_SECONDS = 0.35;

// Two soft sine notes, a fifth apart (tiks' success cue).
const CHIME_SOUND = {
	name: "scratch-card-chime",
	baseFreq: 587,
	noiseColor: "pink",
	oscType: "sine",
	filterFreq: 3000,
	filterQ: 1,
	attack: 0.006,
	decay: 3.2,
	brightness: 2000,
} as const;

type FoilName = "silver" | "gold" | "graphite";

interface FoilPalette {
	/** Base gradient stops, laid along `GRADIENT_ANGLE`. */
	stops: string[];
	/** Peak opacity of the brushed streaks and the fine grain. */
	streak: number;
	grain: number;
	sheen: string;
	/** Engraved hint: the cut is `ink`, its lower lip catches `highlight`. */
	ink: string;
	highlight: string;
	/** Colors for the specks that pop off the brush. */
	flakes: string[];
}

const foils: Record<FoilName, FoilPalette> = {
	silver: {
		stops: ["#f3f4f6", "#cdd1d7", "#eceef1", "#b9bec6", "#e3e6ea", "#c4c9d0"],
		streak: 0.04,
		grain: 0.03,
		sheen: "rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5)",
		ink: "rgb(72 78 88 / 0.5)",
		highlight: "rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75)",
		flakes: ["#e6e8ec", "#c2c7ce", "#f7f8fa", "#aab0b9"],
	},
	gold: {
		stops: ["#f6e7bd", "#d9b56c", "#f3dfa8", "#c39a4c", "#ecd18f", "#cfa85e"],
		streak: 0.045,
		grain: 0.03,
		sheen: "rgb(255 249 230 / 0.6)",
		ink: "rgb(110 76 22 / 0.5)",
		highlight: "rgb(255 246 220 / 0.7)",
		flakes: ["#f1dca2", "#d2ab5f", "#f8ebc6", "#b98f42"],
	},
	graphite: {
		stops: ["#6b7078", "#43474e", "#5e636b", "#363a40", "#555a62", "#3d4148"],
		streak: 0.05,
		grain: 0.045,
		sheen: "rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16)",
		ink: "rgb(12 13 16 / 0.78)",
		highlight: "rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2)",
		flakes: ["#73787f", "#4a4e55", "#878c93", "#3a3e44"],
	},
};

function cssGradient(palette: FoilPalette) {
	return `linear-gradient(${GRADIENT_ANGLE}deg, ${palette.stops.join(", ")})`;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
	return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

/** A small seeded random generator, so the foil texture is the same every render. */
function seededRandom(seed: number) {
	let state = seed >>> 0;
	return () => {
		state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
		let t = state;
		t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
		t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
		return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
	};
}

/** End points of a CSS-style linear gradient line at `angle` across a `width` by `height` box. */
function gradientLine(width: number, height: number, angle: number) {
	const radians = (angle * Math.PI) / 180;
	const dx = Math.sin(radians);
	const dy = -Math.cos(radians);
	const half = (Math.abs(width * dx) + Math.abs(height * dy)) / 2;
	return {
		x0: width / 2 - dx * half,
		y0: height / 2 - dy * half,
		x1: width / 2 + dx * half,
		y1: height / 2 + dy * half,
	};
}

function createCanvas(width: number, height: number) {
	const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
	canvas.width = Math.max(1, width);
	canvas.height = Math.max(1, height);
	return canvas;
}

/** Paints the foil artwork (no sheen) at `scale` device px per CSS px. */
function paintFoil(
	canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
	width: number,
	height: number,
	scale: number,
	palette: FoilPalette,
	hint: string,
	fontFamily: string,
) {
	const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
	if (!ctx) return;
	const random = seededRandom(0x5c7a7c4);
	ctx.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
	ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
	ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

	const line = gradientLine(width, height, GRADIENT_ANGLE);
	const base = ctx.createLinearGradient(line.x0, line.y0, line.x1, line.y1);
	palette.stops.forEach((stop, index) => {
		base.addColorStop(index / (palette.stops.length - 1), stop);
	});
	ctx.fillStyle = base;
	ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

	// Brushed metal: thin horizontal streaks of varying length, one device px tall.
	ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
	const deviceWidth = canvas.width;
	const deviceHeight = canvas.height;
	const streaks = Math.round(deviceHeight * 1.6);
	for (let index = 0; index < streaks; index++) {
		const light = random() > 0.45;
		ctx.fillStyle = light ? "#fff" : "#000";
		ctx.globalAlpha = palette.streak * (0.25 + random() * 0.75);
		const length = deviceWidth * (0.2 + random() * 0.9);
		const x = random() * (deviceWidth + length) - length;
		const y = Math.floor(random() * deviceHeight);
		ctx.fillRect(x, y, length, Math.max(1, Math.round(scale / 2)));
	}

	// Fine grain, about half a CSS px per speck so it stays visible at 3x and 4x.
	const speck = Math.max(1, Math.round(scale / 2));
	const tileSize = 64 * speck;
	const tile = createCanvas(tileSize, tileSize);
	const tileCtx = tile.getContext("2d");
	if (tileCtx) {
		const pixels = tileCtx.createImageData(tileSize, tileSize);
		const data = pixels.data;
		for (let y = 0; y < tileSize; y += speck) {
			for (let x = 0; x < tileSize; x += speck) {
				const shade = random() > 0.5 ? 255 : 0;
				const alpha = Math.round(random() * random() * palette.grain * 255 * 2);
				for (let sy = 0; sy < speck; sy++) {
					for (let sx = 0; sx < speck; sx++) {
						const offset = ((y + sy) * tileSize + x + sx) * 4;
						data[offset] = shade;
						data[offset + 1] = shade;
						data[offset + 2] = shade;
						data[offset + 3] = alpha;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		tileCtx.putImageData(pixels, 0, 0);
		const pattern = ctx.createPattern(tile, "repeat");
		if (pattern) {
			ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
			ctx.fillStyle = pattern;
			ctx.fillRect(0, 0, deviceWidth, deviceHeight);
		}
	}

	ctx.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
	ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

	// A soft bevel: the top edge catches light and the bottom edge falls off.
	const bevel = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
	bevel.addColorStop(0, "rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55)");
	bevel.addColorStop(0.5, "rgb(255 255 255 / 0)");
	bevel.addColorStop(0.5, "rgb(0 0 0 / 0)");
	bevel.addColorStop(1, "rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14)");
	ctx.strokeStyle = bevel;
	ctx.lineWidth = 1;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.roundRect(0.5, 0.5, width - 1, height - 1, CORNER_RADIUS - 0.5);
	ctx.stroke();

	// The engraved hint, flanked by two hairlines.
	const label = hint.trim().toLocaleUpperCase();
	if (!label) return;
	const fontSize = clamp(width * 0.042, 10, 14);
	ctx.font = `600 ${fontSize}px ${fontFamily}`;
	ctx.letterSpacing = `${(fontSize * 0.18).toFixed(2)}px`;
	ctx.textAlign = "center";
	ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
	const textWidth = Math.min(ctx.measureText(label).width, width * 0.7);
	const centerX = width / 2;
	const centerY = height / 2;
	const rule = clamp(width * 0.07, 10, 26);
	const gap = fontSize * 0.9;
	const engrave = (color: string, offset: number) => {
		ctx.fillStyle = color;
		ctx.fillText(
			label,
			centerX + fontSize * 0.09,
			centerY + offset,
			width * 0.7,
		);
		const left = centerX - textWidth / 2 - gap;
		const right = centerX + textWidth / 2 + gap;
		ctx.fillRect(left - rule, centerY + offset - 0.5, rule, 1);
		ctx.fillRect(right, centerY + offset - 0.5, rule, 1);
	};
	engrave(palette.highlight, 0.75);
	engrave(palette.ink, 0);
}

/** A soft round dab: solid in the middle, feathered to nothing at the radius. */
function createBrush(radius: number, scale: number) {
	const size = Math.ceil(radius * 2 * scale);
	const brush = createCanvas(size, size);
	const ctx = brush.getContext("2d");
	if (!ctx) return brush;
	const center = size / 2;
	const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
		center,
		center,
		0,
		center,
		center,
		center,
	);
	gradient.addColorStop(0, "rgb(0 0 0 / 1)");
	gradient.addColorStop(0.7, "rgb(0 0 0 / 1)");
	gradient.addColorStop(0.86, "rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6)");
	gradient.addColorStop(1, "rgb(0 0 0 / 0)");
	ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
	ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
	return brush;
}

/** Squared distance from a point to the segment `a`→`b`. */
function distanceToSegmentSq(
	px: number,
	py: number,
	ax: number,
	ay: number,
	bx: number,
	by: number,
) {
	const dx = bx - ax;
	const dy = by - ay;
	const lengthSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
	const t =
		lengthSq > 0
			? clamp(((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / lengthSq, 0, 1)
			: 0;
	const x = ax + dx * t - px;
	const y = ay + dy * t - py;
	return x * x + y * y;
}

interface ScratchAudio {
	ctx: AudioContext;
	output: GainNode;
	noise: AudioBuffer;
}

let scratchAudio: ScratchAudio | null = null;

/** One shared context for every card, created on the first scratch (a user gesture). */
function getScratchAudio() {
	if (scratchAudio && scratchAudio.ctx.state !== "closed") return scratchAudio;
	const AudioContextClass =
		window.AudioContext ??
		(window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext })
			.webkitAudioContext;
	if (!AudioContextClass) return null;
	const ctx = new AudioContextClass();
	const output = ctx.createGain();
	output.gain.value = 0.8;
	output.connect(ctx.destination);
	// Grainy noise with sparse louder crackles, like foil catching under a nail.
	const noise = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate, ctx.sampleRate);
	const data = noise.getChannelData(0);
	for (let index = 0; index < data.length; index++) {
		const crackle = Math.random() < 0.035 ? 1 : 0.4;
		data[index] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * crackle;
	}
	scratchAudio = { ctx, output, noise };
	return scratchAudio;
}

/** Plays one short burst of filtered noise. Starts and ends at zero gain, so it never clicks. */
function playScratchGrain(
	audio: ScratchAudio,
	loudness: number,
	brightness: number,
) {
	const { ctx } = audio;
	if (ctx.state === "suspended") void ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
	const start = ctx.currentTime + 0.005;
	const source = ctx.createBufferSource();
	source.buffer = audio.noise;
	const band = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
	band.type = "bandpass";
	band.frequency.value = 1500 + brightness * 4500;
	band.Q.value = 0.9;
	const highpass = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
	highpass.type = "highpass";
	highpass.frequency.value = 700;
	const gain = ctx.createGain();
	const peak = loudness * (0.75 + Math.random() * 0.5);
	gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, start);
	gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, start + GRAIN_SECONDS * 0.25);
	gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, start + GRAIN_SECONDS);
	source.connect(band);
	band.connect(highpass);
	highpass.connect(gain);
	gain.connect(audio.output);
	const offset = Math.random() * (audio.noise.duration - GRAIN_SECONDS - 0.02);
	source.start(start, offset, GRAIN_SECONDS + 0.01);
}

interface Flake {
	x: number;
	y: number;
	vx: number;
	vy: number;
	angle: number;
	spin: number;
	width: number;
	height: number;
	age: number;
	life: number;
	color: string;
}

interface Stroke {
	pointerId: number;
	x: number;
	y: number;
	time: number;
	/** Smoothed pointer speed, in px/ms. */
	speed: number;
	/** Converts client px to the card's layout px (accounts for CSS transforms and zoom). */
	left: number;
	top: number;
	ratioX: number;
	ratioY: number;
	freshAt: number;
	hapticDistance: number;
	flakeDistance: number;
	lastGrainAt: number;
}

export interface ScratchCardHandle {
	/** Puts a fresh foil back over the content. Silent. */
	reset: () => void;
	/** Reveals the content at once, as if scratched clear. Silent. */
	reveal: () => void;
}

export interface ScratchCardProps
	extends Omit<ComponentProps<"div">, "children" | "onProgress" | "ref"> {
	/** The content under the foil. Hidden from assistive technology until revealed. */
	children?: ReactNode;
	/** Fraction of the foil, 0 to 1, that has to be cleared before the rest lifts off. */
	threshold?: number;
	/** The foil finish. */
	foil?: FoilName;
	/** Engraved into the foil, and scratched away with it. */
	hint?: string;
	/** Called once, when the card is revealed by scratching, the button, a key, or `reveal()`. */
	onReveal?: () => void;
	/** Called with the cleared fraction, 0 to 1, as the foil is scratched. */
	onProgress?: (fraction: number) => void;
	disabled?: boolean;
	/** Play a scratch texture that follows the pointer speed, and a chime on reveal. */
	sound?: boolean;
	/** Trigger haptics on supported devices. */
	haptics?: boolean;
	/** Exposes `reset()` and `reveal()`. */
	ref?: Ref<ScratchCardHandle>;
}

export function ScratchCard({
	children,
	threshold = 0.6,
	foil = "silver",
	hint = "Scratch here",
	onReveal,
	onProgress,
	disabled = false,
	sound = true,
	haptics = true,
	className,
	ref,
	"aria-label": ariaLabel,
	"aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledBy,
	...props
}: ScratchCardProps) {
	const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false);
	const palette = foils[foil] ?? foils.silver;

	const reducedMotion = useReducedMotion() ?? false;
	const { trigger: haptic } = useWebHaptics();
	// Sound stays on under reduced motion; only movement is reduced.
	const { success: playChime } = useTiks({
		theme: CHIME_SOUND,
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});

	const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const foilRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const fallbackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
	const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

	const sizeRef = useRef({ width: 0, height: 0, scale: 0 });
	const baseRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
	const maskRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
	const brushRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
	const gridRef = useRef(new Uint8Array(GRID_COLUMNS * GRID_ROWS));
	const clearedRef = useRef(0);
	const progressRef = useRef(0);
	const revealedRef = useRef(false);
	const strokeRef = useRef<Stroke | null>(null);
	const flakesRef = useRef<Flake[]>([]);
	const sheenRef = useRef({ value: SHEEN_REST, target: SHEEN_REST });
	const frameRef = useRef(0);
	const lastFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
	const lastHapticAtRef = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
	const focusContentRef = useRef(false);

	// Event handlers and the frame loop read the latest props through refs.
	const latest = useRef({
		threshold,
		palette,
		hint,
		onReveal,
		onProgress,
		disabled,
		sound,
		haptics,
		reducedMotion,
	});
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		latest.current = {
			threshold,
			palette,
			hint,
			onReveal,
			onProgress,
			disabled,
			sound,
			haptics,
			reducedMotion,
		};
	});

	const brushRadius = () =>
		clamp(sizeRef.current.width * BRUSH_FRACTION, MIN_BRUSH_PX, MAX_BRUSH_PX);

	const silent = () =>
		typeof document !== "undefined" && document.visibilityState === "hidden";

	const composite = () => {
		const canvas = canvasRef.current;
		const base = baseRef.current;
		const mask = maskRef.current;
		if (!canvas || !base || !mask) return;
		const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
		if (!ctx) return;
		const { width, height, scale } = sizeRef.current;
		ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
		ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
		ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "copy";
		ctx.drawImage(base, 0, 0);

		// A diagonal sheen across the foil that drifts a little with the pointer.
		ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
		ctx.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
		const line = gradientLine(width, height, GRADIENT_ANGLE);
		const sheen = ctx.createLinearGradient(line.x0, line.y0, line.x1, line.y1);
		const at = sheenRef.current.value;
		sheen.addColorStop(clamp(at - 0.2, 0, 1), "rgb(255 255 255 / 0)");
		sheen.addColorStop(clamp(at, 0, 1), latest.current.palette.sheen);
		sheen.addColorStop(clamp(at + 0.2, 0, 1), "rgb(255 255 255 / 0)");
		ctx.fillStyle = sheen;
		ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

		// Cut the scratched areas out of the foil and its sheen.
		ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
		ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-in";
		ctx.drawImage(mask, 0, 0);

		ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

			const cos = Math.cos(flake.angle) * scale;
			const sin = Math.sin(flake.angle) * scale;
			ctx.setTransform(cos, sin, -sin, cos, flake.x * scale, flake.y * scale);
			ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - (flake.age / flake.life) ** 2;
			ctx.fillStyle = flake.color;
			ctx.fillRect(
				-flake.width / 2,
				-flake.height / 2,
				flake.width,
				flake.height,
			);
		}
		ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
		ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
	};

	const frame = (now: number) => {
		frameRef.current = 0;
		const elapsed =
			lastFrameRef.current === null
				? 1 / 60
				: Math.min((now - lastFrameRef.current) / 1000, 1 / 20);
		lastFrameRef.current = now;
		let moving = false;

		const sheen = sheenRef.current;
		sheen.value +=
			(sheen.target - sheen.value) * (1 - Math.exp(-elapsed / 0.14));
		if (Math.abs(sheen.target - sheen.value) < 0.0008)
			sheen.value = sheen.target;
		else moving = true;

		const flakes = flakesRef.current;
		for (let index = flakes.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
			const flake = flakes[index];
			flake.age += elapsed;
			if (flake.age >= flake.life) {
				flakes.splice(index, 1);
				continue;
			}
			flake.vy += 700 * elapsed;
			flake.x += flake.vx * elapsed;
			flake.y += flake.vy * elapsed;
			flake.angle += flake.spin * elapsed;

		const { width, height, scale } = sizeRef.current;
		const base = baseRef.current;
		const root = rootRef.current;

		const fontFamily = getComputedStyle(root).fontFamily || "sans-serif";
		paintFoil(
			base,
			width,
			height,
			scale,
			latest.current.palette,
			latest.current.hint,
			fontFamily,
		);
	};

	/** Sizes the canvases to the card, keeping what was scratched as a fraction of the area. */
	const layout = (force = false) => {
		const root = rootRef.current;
		const canvas = canvasRef.current;
		if (!root || !canvas) return;
		const width = root.clientWidth;
		const height = root.clientHeight;
		if (!width || !height) return;
		const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
		const zoom = rect.width / width;
		const cssZoom =
			(root as HTMLElement & { currentCSSZoom?: number }).currentCSSZoom ?? 1;
		const scale = clamp(
			window.devicePixelRatio * Math.max(zoom, cssZoom, 1e-3),
			1,
			MAX_BACKING_SCALE,
		);
		const current = sizeRef.current;
		if (
			!force &&
			current.width === width &&
			current.height === height &&
			current.scale === scale &&
			maskRef.current
		) {
			return;
		}
		sizeRef.current = { width, height, scale };
		const deviceWidth = Math.round(width * scale);
		const deviceHeight = Math.round(height * scale);
		canvas.width = deviceWidth;
		canvas.height = deviceHeight;

		const previous = maskRef.current;
		const mask = createCanvas(deviceWidth, deviceHeight);
		const maskCtx = mask.getContext("2d");
		if (maskCtx) {
			if (previous) {
				maskCtx.drawImage(previous, 0, 0, deviceWidth, deviceHeight);
			} else {
				maskCtx.fillStyle = "#000";
				maskCtx.fillRect(0, 0, deviceWidth, deviceHeight);
			}
		}
		maskRef.current = mask;
		baseRef.current = createCanvas(deviceWidth, deviceHeight);
		brushRef.current = createBrush(brushRadius(), scale);

		composite();
		if (fallbackRef.current) fallbackRef.current.hidden = true;
	};

	const layoutRef = useRef(layout);
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		layoutRef.current = layout;
	});

	const setProgress = (fraction: number) => {
		const rounded = Math.round(fraction * 100) / 100;
		if (rounded === progressRef.current) return;
		progressRef.current = rounded;
		latest.current.onProgress?.(rounded);
	};

	/** Clears grid cells along the segment and returns how many were newly cleared. */
	const markSegment = (ax: number, ay: number, bx: number, by: number) => {
		const { width, height } = sizeRef.current;
		const reach = brushRadius() * CLEAR_REACH;
		const reachSq = reach * reach;
		const cellWidth = width / GRID_COLUMNS;
		const cellHeight = height / GRID_ROWS;
		const fromColumn = clamp(
			Math.floor((Math.min(ax, bx) - reach) / cellWidth),
			0,
			GRID_COLUMNS - 1,
		);
		const toColumn = clamp(
			Math.floor((Math.max(ax, bx) + reach) / cellWidth),
			0,
			GRID_COLUMNS - 1,
		);
		const fromRow = clamp(
			Math.floor((Math.min(ay, by) - reach) / cellHeight),
			0,
			GRID_ROWS - 1,
		);
		const toRow = clamp(
			Math.floor((Math.max(ay, by) + reach) / cellHeight),
			0,
			GRID_ROWS - 1,
		);
		const grid = gridRef.current;
		let cleared = 0;
		for (let row = fromRow; row <= toRow; row++) {
			const cy = (row + 0.5) * cellHeight;
			for (let column = fromColumn; column <= toColumn; column++) {
				const cell = row * GRID_COLUMNS + column;
				if (grid[cell]) continue;
				const cx = (column + 0.5) * cellWidth;
				if (distanceToSegmentSq(cx, cy, ax, ay, bx, by) <= reachSq) {
					grid[cell] = 1;
					cleared++;
				}
			}
		}
		clearedRef.current += cleared;
		return cleared;
	};

	/** Erases the foil along the segment with soft round dabs, spaced so fast flicks leave no gaps. */
	const eraseSegment = (ax: number, ay: number, bx: number, by: number) => {
		const mask = maskRef.current;
		const brush = brushRef.current;
		if (!mask || !brush) return;
		const ctx = mask.getContext("2d");
		if (!ctx) return;
		const { scale } = sizeRef.current;
		const radius = brushRadius();
		const distance = Math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay);
		const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(distance / (radius * DAB_SPACING)));
		ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
		for (let step = 1; step <= steps; step++) {
			const t = step / steps;
			// A little jitter roughens the edge, like foil flaking rather than a clean cut.
			const size = radius * (0.92 + Math.random() * 0.16) * 2 * scale;
			const x =
				(ax + (bx - ax) * t) * scale + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4 * scale;
			const y =
				(ay + (by - ay) * t) * scale + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4 * scale;
			ctx.drawImage(brush, x - size / 2, y - size / 2, size, size);
		}
		ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
	};

	const spawnFlake = (x: number, y: number, dx: number, dy: number) => {
		const flakes = flakesRef.current;
		if (flakes.length >= MAX_FLAKES) return;
		const colors = latest.current.palette.flakes;
		const radius = brushRadius();
		const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
		// Specks fly off to either side of the stroke, a little upward.
		const side = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
		const speed = 50 + Math.random() * 110;
		const normalX = (-dy / length) * side;
		const normalY = (dx / length) * side;
		flakes.push({
			x: x + normalX * radius * 0.6,
			y: y + normalY * radius * 0.6,
			vx: normalX * speed + (dx / length) * 30 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,
			vy: normalY * speed - 70 - Math.random() * 60,
			angle: Math.random() * Math.PI,
			spin: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18,
			width: 1.2 + Math.random() * 1.8,
			height: 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.2,
			age: 0,
			life: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.3,
			color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)] ?? "#ccc",
		});
	};

	const endStroke = () => {
		const stroke = strokeRef.current;
		if (!stroke) return;
		strokeRef.current = null;
		const foilElement = foilRef.current;

			foilElement.releasePointerCapture(stroke.pointerId);

		revealedRef.current = true;
		endStroke();
		flakesRef.current = [];
		sheenRef.current.target = SHEEN_REST;

			root && document.activeElement && root.contains(document.activeElement),
		);

		latest.current.onReveal?.();

		flakesRef.current = [];

					audio,

			SHEEN_REST +
			(x / width - 0.5) * SHEEN_PARALLAX +
			(y / height - 0.5) * SHEEN_PARALLAX * 0.4;
		wake();
	};

		const root = rootRef.current;
		const rect = root?.getBoundingClientRect();
		if (!root || !rect?.width || !rect.height) return null;
		return {
			x: (clientX - rect.left) * (root.clientWidth / rect.width),
			y: (clientY - rect.top) * (root.clientHeight / rect.height),
		};
	};

		if (latest.current.disabled || revealedRef.current) return;

		if (!event.isPrimary || strokeRef.current) return;
		if (event.pointerType === "mouse" && event.button !== 0) return;
		const root = rootRef.current;
		const rect = root?.getBoundingClientRect();
		if (!root || !rect?.width || !rect.height) return;

		event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		const ratioX = root.clientWidth / rect.width;
		const ratioY = root.clientHeight / rect.height;
		const x = (event.clientX - rect.left) * ratioX;
		const y = (event.clientY - rect.top) * ratioY;
		strokeRef.current = {
			pointerId: event.pointerId,
			x,
			y,
			time: event.timeStamp,
			speed: 0,
			left: rect.left,
			top: rect.top,
			ratioX,
			ratioY,
			freshAt: Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
			hapticDistance: 0,
			flakeDistance: 0,
			lastGrainAt: Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
		};

		if (latest.current.sound) getScratchAudio();

		eraseSegment(x, y, x, y);
		if (markSegment(x, y, x, y)) {
			strokeRef.current.freshAt = event.timeStamp;
			setProgress(clearedRef.current / gridRef.current.length);
		}
		followSheen(x, y);
		wake();
	};

	const onPointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const stroke = strokeRef.current;
		if (!stroke) {
			// Hovering with a mouse tilts the sheen.
			if (event.pointerType === "mouse" && !revealedRef.current) {
				const point = toLocal(event.clientX, event.clientY);
				if (point) followSheen(point.x, point.y);
			}
			return;
		}
		if (event.pointerId !== stroke.pointerId) return;
		const native = event.nativeEvent;
		const coalesced = native.getCoalescedEvents?.() ?? [];
		const points = coalesced.length ? coalesced : [native];
		for (const point of points) {
			const current = strokeRef.current;
			if (!current) break;
			scratchTo(
				(point.clientX - current.left) * current.ratioX,
				(point.clientY - current.top) * current.ratioY,
				point.timeStamp,
			);
		}
		const last = strokeRef.current;
		if (last) followSheen(last.x, last.y);
		wake();
		const fraction = clearedRef.current / gridRef.current.length;
		setProgress(fraction);
		if (fraction >= clamp(latest.current.threshold, 0.05, 1)) reveal(true);
	};

	const onPointerEnd = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (strokeRef.current?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		endStroke();
	};

	const onPointerLeave = () => {
		if (strokeRef.current) return;
		sheenRef.current.target = SHEEN_REST;
		wake();
	};

	const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (latest.current.disabled || revealedRef.current) return;
		if (event.key !== "Enter" && event.key !== " ") return;
		event.preventDefault();
		reveal(true);
	};

	const transition = {
		duration: reducedMotion ? 0 : REVEAL_SECONDS,
		ease: revealEase,
	};

	return (
		<div
			ref={rootRef}
			role="group"
			aria-label={ariaLabelledBy ? ariaLabel : (ariaLabel ?? "Scratch card")}
			aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy}
			aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
			data-slot="scratch-card"
			data-foil={foil}
			data-state={revealed ? "revealed" : "covered"}
			data-disabled={disabled || undefined}
			className={cn(
				"group/scratch-card relative isolate aspect-[28/17] w-full max-w-80 select-none overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-black/[0.07] bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgb(0_0_0/0.05),0_10px_28px_-14px_rgb(0_0_0/0.28)] dark:border-white/10 dark:shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgb(0_0_0/0.4),0_12px_32px_-14px_rgb(0_0_0/0.7)]",
				className,
			)}
			{...props}
		>
			<motion.div
				ref={contentRef}
				tabIndex={-1}
				aria-hidden={!revealed}
				inert={!revealed}
				initial={false}
				animate={{ scale: revealed ? 1 : 0.98 }}
				transition={revealed ? transition : { duration: 0 }}
				className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden outline-none"
			>
				{children}
			</motion.div>

			<AnimatePresence initial={false}>
				{revealed ? null : (
					<motion.div
						key="foil"
						ref={foilRef}
						tabIndex={-1}
						aria-hidden
						initial={false}
						animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
						exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: reducedMotion ? 1 : 1.04 }}
						transition={transition}
						onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
						onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
						onPointerUp={onPointerEnd}
						onPointerCancel={onPointerEnd}
						onLostPointerCapture={onPointerEnd}
						onPointerLeave={onPointerLeave}
						onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
						className="absolute inset-0 cursor-crosshair touch-none outline-none group-data-disabled/scratch-card:cursor-not-allowed group-data-disabled/scratch-card:opacity-60"
					>
						{/* Shown until the canvas paints, so server HTML never shows the content. */}
						<div
							ref={fallbackRef}
							className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center font-semibold text-[11px] text-black/40 uppercase tracking-[0.18em]"
							style={{ background: cssGradient(palette) }}
						>
							{hint}
						</div>
						<canvas ref={canvasRef} className="absolute inset-0 size-full" />
					</motion.div>
				)}
			</AnimatePresence>

			{revealed ? null : (
				<button
					type="button"
					disabled={disabled}
					onClick={() => reveal(true)}
					className="absolute right-2 bottom-2 z-10 inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-full bg-background/85 px-3 font-medium text-foreground text-xs opacity-0 pointer-coarse:opacity-100 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgb(0_0_0/0.12)] outline-none ring-1 ring-black/5 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:opacity-100 focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 group-hover/scratch-card:opacity-100 group-data-scratching/scratch-card:invisible group-data-disabled/scratch-card:hidden motion-reduce:transition-none dark:ring-white/10"
				>
					Reveal
				</button>
			)}

			<span role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
				{revealed ? "Revealed" : ""}
			</span>
		</div>
	);

	type PointerEvent,
	useEffect,
	useId,
	useLayoutEffect,
	useRef,
	useState,
	useSyncExternalStore,
} from "react";
import { useWebHaptics } from "web-haptics/react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// Layout, in px. The chain hangs from the fixture at the top-center of the box.
const WIDTH = 200;
const HEIGHT = 304;
const CENTER_X = WIDTH / 2;
/** Where the chain leaves the fixture. */
const ANCHOR_Y = 49;
/** Center-to-center distance between beads. */
const BEAD_PITCH = 7;
const BEAD_RADIUS = 2.6;
/** Beads hanging below the fixture at rest. */
const REST_BEADS = 20;
const REST_LENGTH = REST_BEADS * BEAD_PITCH;
/** The handle's pivot, where the last bead is crimped in, at rest. */
const REST_PIVOT_Y = ANCHOR_Y + REST_LENGTH;
/** From the handle's pivot to its center of mass. */
const HANDLE_ARM = 30;
/** The pivot's spot inside the handle button. */
const PIVOT_IN_BUTTON = { x: 24, y: 3 } as const;

// Pulling, in px of chain fed out of the fixture.
/** Pull before the chain starts to rubber-band. */
const TRAVEL = 44;
/** Pull that flips the switch on release. */
const THRESHOLD = 28;
/** Furthest the chain rubber-bands past `TRAVEL`. */
const MAX_BAND = 14;
/** Furthest the handle follows the pointer sideways. */
const MAX_SWAY = 24;
/** Sideways pointer travel the handle follows, as a fraction. */
const SWAY_FACTOR = 0.6;
/** Pointer travel before a press becomes a pull. */
const DRAG_SLOP = 3;
/** How far a click or key press pulls the chain. */
const TUG_DEPTH = 38;
/** Tug speed in px/s: one bead per 47 ms, so each bead keeps its own tick. */
const TUG_SPEED = 150;
/** Seconds a tug rests at the bottom before letting go. */
const TUG_HOLD = 0.06;
/** A tug leans this far sideways, alternating sides, so the chain swings. */
const TUG_SWAY = 12;
/** Seconds the handle eases home with reduced motion. */
const RETURN_DURATION = 0.22;
/** Minimum ms between bead ticks. Two 60 Hz frames still fit. */
const CUE_THROTTLE_MS = 32;

// Physics, in px and seconds. A verlet rope with a two-node rigid handle.
const SEGMENTS = 20;
const PIVOT = SEGMENTS;
const WEIGHT = SEGMENTS + 1;
const NODES = SEGMENTS + 2;
const GRAVITY = 9000;
/** Fixed timestep: the same motion at 60 Hz and 120 Hz. */
const STEP = 1 / 240;
/** Longest frame simulated, so a stalled tab doesn't jump. */
const MAX_FRAME = 1 / 20;
const ITERATIONS = 8;
/** The handle outweighs each chain node three to one. */
const HANDLE_MASS = 3;
/** Air drag on the chain and handle, per second. */
const CHAIN_DAMPING = 6;
const HANDLE_DAMPING = 4;
/**
 * Friction that ramps in after a release, like a real chain losing its last
 * sway, so the rope rests within about 1.5 s instead of shivering.
 */
const SETTLE_FRICTION = 14;
const SETTLE_FRICTION_AFTER = 0.9;
const SETTLE_FRICTION_RAMP = 0.5;
/** Velocity correction from the follow-the-leader pass, which keeps the rope from buzzing. */
const LEADER_DAMPING = 0.5;
/** How quickly a held handle catches up with the pointer, per second. */
const PIN_RATE = 40;
const PIN_BLEND = 1 - Math.exp(-PIN_RATE * STEP);
/** The switch's return spring, which reels the chain back in. */
const RECOIL_STIFFNESS = 520;
const RECOIL_DAMPING = 2 * 0.42 * Math.sqrt(RECOIL_STIFFNESS);
/** Settled once every node stays this close to rest for `SETTLE_FRAMES`. */
const SETTLE_DISTANCE = 0.25;
const SETTLE_FRAMES = 12;

const MAX_BEADS =
	Math.ceil((REST_LENGTH + TRAVEL + MAX_BAND + 8) / BEAD_PITCH) + 2;

// One soft metallic tick per bead, a firm clack on the flip, and a low thunk
// when the chain hits the end of its travel.
const BEAD_SOUND = {
	name: "pull-cord-bead",
	baseFreq: 660,
	noiseColor: "white",
	oscType: "sine",
	filterFreq: 5200,
	filterQ: 7,
	attack: 0.001,
	decay: 0.8,
	brightness: 6000,
} as const;
const SWITCH_ON_SOUND = {
	name: "pull-cord-on",
	baseFreq: 300,
	noiseColor: "pink",
	oscType: "sine",
	filterFreq: 1400,
	filterQ: 2.5,
	attack: 0.001,
	decay: 1.6,
	brightness: 3000,
} as const;
/** A touch higher than on. */
const SWITCH_OFF_SOUND = {
	...SWITCH_ON_SOUND,
	name: "pull-cord-off",
	baseFreq: 360,
	filterFreq: 1800,
} as const;
const STOP_SOUND = {
	name: "pull-cord-stop",
	baseFreq: 220,
	noiseColor: "pink",
	oscType: "sine",
	filterFreq: 900,
	filterQ: 1,
	attack: 0.002,
	decay: 1.6,
	brightness: 1500,
} as const;

type Mode = "idle" | "drag" | "tug" | "free" | "return";

interface Sim {
	x: Float64Array;
	y: Float64Array;
	px: Float64Array;
	py: Float64Array;
	/** Arc length along the rope at each node, reused by `layoutBeads`. */
	lengths: Float64Array;
	/** Chain fed out past its resting length. */
	feed: number;
	feedVelocity: number;
	mode: Mode;
	/** Pointer offset from the resting pivot, before rubber banding. */
	pullX: number;
	pullY: number;
	/** Pull, in px, where the current tug or return started. */
	fromX: number;
	fromY: number;
	elapsed: number;
	/** Seconds since the handle was let go. */
	freeTime: number;
	/** Side the next tug leans to. */
	tugSide: 1 | -1;
	accumulator: number;
	lastTime: number | null;
	lastBead: number;
	atStop: boolean;
	calmFrames: number;
}

function restY(node: number) {
	return node === WEIGHT
		? REST_PIVOT_Y + HANDLE_ARM
		: ANCHOR_Y + (node * REST_LENGTH) / SEGMENTS;
}

function createSim(): Sim {
	const sim: Sim = {
		x: new Float64Array(NODES),
		y: new Float64Array(NODES),
		px: new Float64Array(NODES),
		py: new Float64Array(NODES),
		lengths: new Float64Array(SEGMENTS + 1),
		feed: 0,
		feedVelocity: 0,
		mode: "idle",
		pullX: 0,
		pullY: 0,
		fromX: 0,
		fromY: 0,
		elapsed: 0,
		freeTime: 0,
		tugSide: 1,
		accumulator: 0,
		lastTime: null,
		lastBead: 0,
		atStop: false,
		calmFrames: 0,
	};
	settle(sim);
	return sim;
}

/** Puts the rope back at rest, hanging straight down. */
function settle(sim: Sim) {
	for (let node = 0; node < NODES; node++) {
		sim.x[node] = sim.px[node] = CENTER_X;
		sim.y[node] = sim.py[node] = restY(node);
	}
	sim.feed = 0;
	sim.feedVelocity = 0;
	sim.lastBead = 0;
	sim.calmFrames = 0;
}

/** Eases `over` toward `limit`, never reaching it. */
function band(over: number, limit: number) {
	return (over * limit) / (over + limit);
}

/** Where a pull puts the handle's pivot. */
function pullTarget(pullX: number, pullY: number) {
	const down = Math.max(pullY, 0);
	return {
		x: CENTER_X + MAX_SWAY * Math.tanh((pullX * SWAY_FACTOR) / MAX_SWAY),
		y:
			REST_PIVOT_Y +
			(down > TRAVEL ? TRAVEL + band(down - TRAVEL, MAX_BAND) : down),
	};
}

/** Chain fed out when the pivot sits at `x`, `y` with the chain taut. */
function feedAt(x: number, y: number) {
	return Math.max(0, Math.hypot(x - CENTER_X, y - ANCHOR_Y) - REST_LENGTH);
}

/** Advances the rope by one fixed step. A `pin` holds the handle's pivot. */
function stepSim(sim: Sim, pin: { x: number; y: number } | null) {
	const { x, y, px, py } = sim;

	if (pin) {
		px[PIVOT] = x[PIVOT];
		py[PIVOT] = y[PIVOT];
		x[PIVOT] += (pin.x - x[PIVOT]) * PIN_BLEND;
		y[PIVOT] += (pin.y - y[PIVOT]) * PIN_BLEND;
		const feed = feedAt(x[PIVOT], y[PIVOT]);
		sim.feedVelocity = (feed - sim.feed) / STEP;
		sim.feed = feed;
	} else {
		// The return spring reels the chain in until the stop bead hits the fixture.
		sim.feedVelocity +=
			(-RECOIL_STIFFNESS * sim.feed - RECOIL_DAMPING * sim.feedVelocity) * STEP;
		sim.feed += sim.feedVelocity * STEP;
		if (sim.feed <= 0) {
			sim.feed = 0;
			sim.feedVelocity = 0;
		}
	}

	let friction = 0;
	if (!pin) {
		sim.freeTime += STEP;
		friction =
			SETTLE_FRICTION *
			Math.min(
				Math.max(
					(sim.freeTime - SETTLE_FRICTION_AFTER) / SETTLE_FRICTION_RAMP,
					0,
				),
				1,
			);
	}
	const chainKeep = Math.exp(-(CHAIN_DAMPING + friction) * STEP);
	const handleKeep = Math.exp(-(HANDLE_DAMPING + friction) * STEP);
	const fall = GRAVITY * STEP * STEP;
	for (let node = 1; node < NODES; node++) {
		if (pin && node === PIVOT) continue;
		const keep = node >= PIVOT ? handleKeep : chainKeep;
		const vx = (x[node] - px[node]) * keep;
		const vy = (y[node] - py[node]) * keep;
		px[node] = x[node];
		py[node] = y[node];
		x[node] += vx;
		y[node] += vy + fall;
	}

	const segment = (REST_LENGTH + sim.feed) / SEGMENTS;
	const weightOf = (node: number) => {
		if (node === 0 || (pin && node === PIVOT)) return 0;
		return node >= PIVOT ? 1 / HANDLE_MASS : 1;
	};
	for (let pass = 0; pass < ITERATIONS; pass++) {
		for (let node = 0; node < NODES - 1; node++) {
			const wa = weightOf(node);
			const wb = weightOf(node + 1);
			const total = wa + wb;
			if (!total) continue;
			const dx = x[node + 1] - x[node];
			const dy = y[node + 1] - y[node];
			const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1e-6;
			const rest = node < SEGMENTS ? segment : HANDLE_ARM;
			const push = (distance - rest) / distance / total;
			x[node] += dx * push * wa;
			y[node] += dy * push * wa;
			x[node + 1] -= dx * push * wb;
			y[node + 1] -= dy * push * wb;
		}
	}

	// Follow the leader from the fixture down, so the chain never stretches
	// and the handle stays rigid. A chain can still go slack.
	for (let node = 1; node < NODES; node++) {
		if (pin && node === PIVOT) continue;
		const rest = node <= SEGMENTS ? segment : HANDLE_ARM;
		const dx = x[node] - x[node - 1];
		const dy = y[node] - y[node - 1];
		const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1e-6;
		if (node <= SEGMENTS && distance <= rest) continue;
		const nextX = x[node - 1] + (dx / distance) * rest;
		const nextY = y[node - 1] + (dy / distance) * rest;
		if (node > 1 && !(pin && node - 1 === PIVOT)) {
			px[node - 1] += (nextX - x[node]) * LEADER_DAMPING;
			py[node - 1] += (nextY - y[node]) * LEADER_DAMPING;
		}
		x[node] = nextX;
		y[node] = nextY;
	}
}

/** Lays the rope out straight from the fixture to `pivotX`, `pivotY`. */
function poseStraight(sim: Sim, pivotX: number, pivotY: number) {
	for (let node = 0; node <= SEGMENTS; node++) {
		const t = node / SEGMENTS;
		sim.x[node] = sim.px[node] = CENTER_X + (pivotX - CENTER_X) * t;
		sim.y[node] = sim.py[node] = ANCHOR_Y + (pivotY - ANCHOR_Y) * t;
	}
	sim.x[WEIGHT] = sim.px[WEIGHT] = pivotX;
	sim.y[WEIGHT] = sim.py[WEIGHT] = pivotY + HANDLE_ARM;
	sim.feed = feedAt(pivotX, pivotY);
	sim.feedVelocity = 0;
}

/**
 * Places the beads along the rope, counting up from the handle, and returns
 * how many there are. Beads above the fixture's mouth are tucked inside it,
 * so a pull feeds them out one by one.
 */
function layoutBeads(sim: Sim, out: Float64Array) {
	const { x, y, lengths } = sim;
	lengths[0] = 0;
	for (let node = 1; node <= SEGMENTS; node++) {
		lengths[node] =
			lengths[node - 1] +
			Math.hypot(x[node] - x[node - 1], y[node] - y[node - 1]);
	}
	const ropeLength = lengths[SEGMENTS];
	const span = REST_LENGTH + sim.feed;
	const last = Math.min(MAX_BEADS - 1, Math.floor(span / BEAD_PITCH) + 1);
	let segment = 1;
	// From the fixture down, so the segment only ever moves forward.
	for (let bead = last; bead >= 0; bead--) {
		const along = span - bead * BEAD_PITCH;
		if (along <= 0) {
			out[bead * 2] = x[0];
			out[bead * 2 + 1] = y[0] + along;
			continue;
		}
		const at = (along / span) * ropeLength;
		while (segment < SEGMENTS && lengths[segment] < at) segment++;
		const from = lengths[segment - 1];
		const t = (at - from) / (lengths[segment] - from || 1);
		out[bead * 2] = x[segment - 1] + (x[segment] - x[segment - 1]) * t;
		out[bead * 2 + 1] = y[segment - 1] + (y[segment] - y[segment - 1]) * t;
	}
	return last + 1;
}

function round(value: number) {
	return Math.round(value * 100) / 100;
}

function chainPath(points: Float64Array, count: number) {
	let path = "";
	for (let bead = 0; bead < count; bead++) {
		path += `${bead ? "L" : "M"}${round(points[bead * 2])} ${round(points[bead * 2 + 1])}`;
	}
	return path;
}

function handleTransform(sim: Sim) {
	const pivotX = sim.x[PIVOT];
	const pivotY = sim.y[PIVOT];
	const tilt = Math.atan2(sim.x[WEIGHT] - pivotX, sim.y[WEIGHT] - pivotY);
	return `translate(${round(pivotX - PIVOT_IN_BUTTON.x)}px, ${round(pivotY - PIVOT_IN_BUTTON.y)}px) rotate(${round((-tilt * 180) / Math.PI)}deg)`;
}

// The resting pose, rendered on the server and on first paint.
const restSim = createSim();
const restBeads = new Float64Array(MAX_BEADS * 2);
const restCount = layoutBeads(restSim, restBeads);
const restPath = chainPath(restBeads, restCount);
const restTransform = handleTransform(restSim);

const REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY = "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)";

function subscribeToReducedMotion(onStoreChange: () => void) {
	const query = window.matchMedia(REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY);
	query.addEventListener("change", onStoreChange);
	return () => query.removeEventListener("change", onStoreChange);
}

function usePrefersReducedMotion() {
	return useSyncExternalStore(
		subscribeToReducedMotion,
		() => window.matchMedia(REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY).matches,
		() => false,
	);
}

function easeOutCubic(t: number) {
	return 1 - (1 - t) ** 3;
}

export interface PullCordProps
	extends Omit<
		ComponentProps<"div">,
		"children" | "defaultChecked" | "onChange" | "ref"
	> {
	/** Controlled on/off state. */
	checked?: boolean;
	/** Initial state when uncontrolled. */
	defaultChecked?: boolean;
	/** Called when a pull, click, or key press flips the switch. */
	onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
	/** Accessible name of the switch. Ignored when `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is set. */
	label?: string;
	disabled?: boolean;
	/** Submits `"on"` or `"off"` with a native form through a hidden input. */
	name?: string;
	/** Play a tick per bead, a click on the flip, and a thunk at the end of the pull. */
	sound?: boolean;
	/** Trigger haptics on supported devices. */
	haptics?: boolean;
}

export function PullCord({
	checked: checkedProp,
	defaultChecked = false,
	onCheckedChange,
	label = "Light",
	disabled = false,
	name,
	sound = true,
	haptics = true,
	className,
	"aria-label": ariaLabel,
	"aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledBy,
	"aria-describedby": ariaDescribedBy,
	...props
}: PullCordProps) {
	const [internalChecked, setInternalChecked] = useState(defaultChecked);
	const controlled = checkedProp !== undefined;
	const checked = controlled ? checkedProp : internalChecked;
	const [pulling, setPulling] = useState(false);

	const reducedMotion = usePrefersReducedMotion();
	const { trigger: haptic } = useWebHaptics();
	// Sound stays on under reduced motion; only movement is reduced.
	const { click: playBead } = useTiks({
		theme: BEAD_SOUND,
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});
	const {
		click: playSwitchClick,
		toggle: playSwitchClunk,
		setTheme: setSwitchSound,
	} = useTiks({ theme: SWITCH_ON_SOUND, respectReducedMotion: false });
	const { toggle: playStop } = useTiks({
		theme: STOP_SOUND,
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});

	const ids = useId().replace(/[^\w-]/g, "");
	const url = (part: string) => `url(#pull-cord-${ids}-${part})`;
	const gradientId = (part: string) => `pull-cord-${ids}-${part}`;

	const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const handleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
	const chainRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null);
	const beadRefs = useRef<Array<SVGCircleElement | null>>([]);
	const simRef = useRef<Sim | null>(null);
	const beadsRef = useRef<Float64Array | null>(null);
	const shownRef = useRef(restCount);
	const frameRef = useRef(0);
	const lastCueAtRef = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
	const suppressClickRef = useRef(false);
	const dragRef = useRef<{
		pointerId: number;
		originX: number;
		originY: number;
		startX: number;
		startY: number;
		scale: number;
		moved: boolean;
	} | null>(null);

	// Event handlers and the frame loop read the latest props through refs.
	const latest = useRef({
		checked,
		controlled,
		onCheckedChange,
		sound,
		haptics,
		reducedMotion,
	});
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		latest.current = {
			checked,
			controlled,
			onCheckedChange,
			sound,
			haptics,
			reducedMotion,
		};
	});

	const getSim = () => {
		simRef.current ??= createSim();
		return simRef.current;
	};

	const silent = () =>
		typeof document !== "undefined" && document.visibilityState === "hidden";

	const tick = (now: number) => {
		if (now - lastCueAtRef.current < CUE_THROTTLE_MS) return;
		lastCueAtRef.current = now;
		if (silent()) return;
		if (latest.current.sound) playBead();
		if (latest.current.haptics) void haptic("selection");
	};

	const thunk = () => {
		lastCueAtRef.current = performance.now();
		if (silent()) return;
		if (latest.current.sound) playStop(false);
		if (latest.current.haptics) void haptic("soft");
	};

	// Called only for user input, so the first render and prop changes stay quiet.
	const flip = () => {
		const next = !latest.current.checked;
		latest.current.checked = next;
		if (!latest.current.controlled) setInternalChecked(next);
		latest.current.onCheckedChange?.(next);
		lastCueAtRef.current = performance.now();
		if (silent()) return;
		if (latest.current.sound) {
			// The same falling clunk for both, pitched a little lower for on.
			setSwitchSound(next ? SWITCH_ON_SOUND : SWITCH_OFF_SOUND);
			playSwitchClick();
			playSwitchClunk(false);
		}
		if (latest.current.haptics) void haptic("medium");
	};

	const paint = () => {
		const sim = getSim();
		beadsRef.current ??= new Float64Array(MAX_BEADS * 2);
		const beads = beadsRef.current;
		const count = layoutBeads(sim, beads);
		const shown = shownRef.current;
		for (let bead = 0; bead < Math.max(count, shown); bead++) {
			const circle = beadRefs.current[bead];
			if (!circle) continue;
			if (bead >= count) {
				circle.setAttribute("display", "none");
				continue;
			}
			if (bead >= shown) circle.removeAttribute("display");
			circle.setAttribute("cx", String(round(beads[bead * 2])));
			circle.setAttribute("cy", String(round(beads[bead * 2 + 1])));
		}
		shownRef.current = count;
		chainRef.current?.setAttribute("d", chainPath(beads, count));
		if (handleRef.current) {
			handleRef.current.style.transform = handleTransform(sim);
		}
	};

	/** Lets go of the handle; `commit` flips the switch if it was pulled far enough. */
	const release = (commit: boolean) => {
		const sim = getSim();
		const target = pullTarget(sim.pullX, sim.pullY);
		const pulled = feedAt(target.x, target.y);
		if (sim.mode === "tug" || (commit && pulled >= THRESHOLD)) flip();
		if (latest.current.reducedMotion) {
			sim.mode = "return";
			sim.fromX = sim.x[PIVOT] - CENTER_X;
			sim.fromY = sim.y[PIVOT] - REST_PIVOT_Y;
			sim.elapsed = 0;
		} else {
			sim.mode = "free";
			sim.freeTime = 0;
		}
		sim.atStop = false;
		wake();
	};

	const frame = (now: number) => {
		frameRef.current = 0;
		const sim = getSim();
		const elapsed =
			sim.lastTime === null
				? 1 / 60
				: Math.min((now - sim.lastTime) / 1000, MAX_FRAME);
		sim.lastTime = now;
		sim.elapsed += elapsed;

		if (sim.mode === "tug") {
			sim.pullY = Math.min(TUG_DEPTH, sim.fromY + sim.elapsed * TUG_SPEED);
			const progress = (sim.pullY - sim.fromY) / (TUG_DEPTH - sim.fromY || 1);
			sim.pullX = sim.tugSide * TUG_SWAY * progress;
		}
		const held = sim.mode === "drag" || sim.mode === "tug";
		const target = pullTarget(sim.pullX, sim.pullY);

		if (latest.current.reducedMotion) {
			if (held) {
				poseStraight(sim, target.x, target.y);
			} else if (sim.mode === "return") {
				const t = Math.min(sim.elapsed / RETURN_DURATION, 1);
				const left = 1 - easeOutCubic(t);
				poseStraight(
					sim,
					CENTER_X + sim.fromX * left,
					REST_PIVOT_Y + sim.fromY * left,
				);
				if (t >= 1) sim.mode = "idle";
			} else {
				settle(sim);
				sim.mode = "idle";
			}
		} else {
			sim.accumulator += elapsed;
			while (sim.accumulator >= STEP) {
				stepSim(sim, held ? target : null);
				sim.accumulator -= STEP;
			}
		}

		// Each bead that passes the fixture's mouth ticks while the chain is held.
		const bead = Math.floor(sim.feed / BEAD_PITCH);
		if (bead !== sim.lastBead) {
			if (held) tick(now);
			sim.lastBead = bead;
		}
		if (sim.mode === "drag") {
			if (!sim.atStop && sim.pullY >= TRAVEL) {
				sim.atStop = true;
				thunk();
			} else if (sim.atStop && sim.pullY < TRAVEL - 6) {
				sim.atStop = false;
			}
		}
		if (
			sim.mode === "tug" &&
			sim.elapsed >= (TUG_DEPTH - sim.fromY) / TUG_SPEED + TUG_HOLD
		) {
			release(true);
		}

		if (sim.mode === "free" && sim.feed === 0) {
			let farthest = 0;
			for (let node = 1; node < NODES; node++) {
				farthest = Math.max(
					farthest,
					Math.abs(sim.x[node] - CENTER_X),
					Math.abs(sim.y[node] - restY(node)),
				);
			}
			sim.calmFrames = farthest < SETTLE_DISTANCE ? sim.calmFrames + 1 : 0;
			// Snap the last fraction of a pixel so the chain rests perfectly still.
			if (sim.calmFrames >= SETTLE_FRAMES) {
				settle(sim);
				sim.mode = "idle";
			}
		}

		paint();
		if (sim.mode !== "idle") wake();
		else sim.lastTime = null;
	};

	const frameHandlerRef = useRef(frame);
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		frameHandlerRef.current = frame;
	});

	function wake() {
		if (frameRef.current) return;
		frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame((now) =>
			frameHandlerRef.current(now),
		);
	}

	useEffect(() => () => cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current), []);

	const tug = () => {
		const sim = getSim();
		if (sim.mode === "drag" || sim.mode === "tug") return;
		if (latest.current.reducedMotion) {
			flip();
			return;
		}
		sim.mode = "tug";
		sim.fromY = Math.max(0, sim.y[PIVOT] - REST_PIVOT_Y);
		sim.pullY = sim.fromY;
		sim.pullX = 0;
		sim.tugSide = sim.tugSide > 0 ? -1 : 1;
		sim.elapsed = 0;
		sim.lastBead = Math.floor(sim.feed / BEAD_PITCH);
		wake();
	};

	const scaleOf = () => {
		const root = rootRef.current;

		return root.getBoundingClientRect().width / (root.offsetWidth || 1) || 1;
	};

		suppressClickRef.current = false;

	};

		<div
			ref={rootRef}

			data-state={state}
			data-pulling={pulling || undefined}
			data-disabled={disabled || undefined}
