		inlineThick: 46,
		padding: 16,
		text: "text-sm",
		icon: "[&_svg]:size-4",
		gap: "gap-3",
	},
	lg: {
		thin: 8,
		thick: 16,
		inlineThin: 48,
		inlineThick: 54,
		padding: 18,
		text: "text-base",
		icon: "[&_svg]:size-5",
		gap: "gap-3.5",
	},
} as const;

type Direction = 1 | -1;

export interface ElasticSliderMark {
	value: number;
	/** Shown under the track; clicking it moves the slider there. */
	label?: string;
}

export interface ElasticSliderProps
	extends Omit<ComponentProps<"div">, "children" | "defaultValue" | "ref"> {
	/** Visible label, also the slider's accessible name. */
	label: string;
	/** Keeps the label for assistive technology only. */
	hideLabel?: boolean;
	/** Controlled value. */
	value?: number;
	/** Initial value when uncontrolled. Defaults to `min`. */
	defaultValue?: number;
	/** Called on every change while dragging, clicking, or pressing keys. */
	onValueChange?: (value: number) => void;
	/** Called once a drag is released, or a click, key press, or mark lands. */
	onValueCommit?: (value: number) => void;
	min?: number;
	max?: number;
	step?: number;
	/** Moved by `Shift`+arrows and `PageUp`/`PageDown`. Defaults to a tenth of the range. */
	largeStep?: number;
	/** Detents a drag sticks to. Labelled marks render under the track. */
	marks?: Array<number | ElasticSliderMark>;
	/** Formats the readout and `aria-valuetext`. */
	format?: (value: number) => string;
	/** Shown before the track, nudged outward when it stretches past `min`. */
	startIcon?: ReactNode;
	/** Shown after the track, nudged outward when it stretches past `max`. */
	endIcon?: ReactNode;
	/** `inline` puts the label and value inside the track; `stacked` puts them above a thin track. */
	variant?: "inline" | "stacked";
	size?: keyof typeof sizes;
	/** Furthest the track stretches past either end, in px. */
	maxStretch?: number;
	/** Play a tick per step or mark and a thunk at the limits. */
	sound?: boolean;
	/** Trigger haptics on supported devices. */
	haptics?: boolean;
	disabled?: boolean;
	/** Submits the value with a native form through a hidden input. */
	name?: string;
	className?: string;
}

function decimalsOf(value: number) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
	const text = String(value);
	if (text.includes("e-")) return Number(text.split("e-")[1]);
	return text.split(".")[1]?.length ?? 0;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
	return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

/**
 * Square-root resistance: follows the pointer 1:1 at first, then eases towards
 * `max` px and never passes it.
 */
function resist(over: number, max: number) {
	if (over <= 0 || max <= 0) return 0;
	return max * (1 - Math.exp(1 - Math.sqrt(1 + (2 * over) / max)));
}

/** Labels at the ends align to the edge, so they never overflow the track. */
function labelShift(fraction: number) {
	if (fraction < 0.1) return fraction * 5;
	if (fraction > 0.9) return 0.5 + (fraction - 0.9) * 5;
	return 0.5;
}

interface Scale {
	lower: number;
	upper: number;
	step: number;
	decimals: number;
	/** Values that tick; `null` ticks on every step. */
	ticks: number[] | null;
	marks: ElasticSliderMark[];
	round: (value: number) => number;
	/** Nearest valid value; `max` counts even when the steps don't reach it. */
	snap: (value: number) => number;
	/** The next valid value above or below. */
	stepFrom: (value: number, direction: Direction) => number;
	fractionOf: (value: number) => number;
}

function buildScale(
	min: number,
	max: number,
	step: number,
	marks?: Array<number | ElasticSliderMark>,
): Scale {
	const lower = Number.isFinite(min) ? min : 0;
	const upper = Number.isFinite(max) ? Math.max(max, lower) : lower;
	const safeStep = Number.isFinite(step) && step > 0 ? step : 1;
	const decimals = Math.max(decimalsOf(safeStep), decimalsOf(lower));
	const span = upper - lower;
	// Round to the step's precision so 0.1 + 0.2 lands on 0.3.
	const round = (value: number) => Number(value.toFixed(decimals));

	const snap = (value: number) => {
		if (!(value > lower)) return lower;
		if (value >= upper) return upper;
		// The ratio is rounded first so 0.175 / 0.05 counts as 3.5, not 3.4999….
		const steps = Number(((value - lower) / safeStep).toFixed(9));
		const snapped = round(lower + Math.round(steps) * safeStep);
		// A step that doesn't divide the range still lets the end reach `max`.
		if (snapped > upper || upper - value < Math.abs(snapped - value)) {
			return upper;
		}
		return snapped;
	};

	const stepFrom = (value: number, direction: Direction) => {
		const steps = (value - lower) / safeStep;
		const index =
			direction > 0
				? Math.floor(steps + 1e-9) + 1
				: Math.ceil(steps - 1e-9) - 1;
		return clamp(round(lower + index * safeStep), lower, upper);
	};

	const normalizedMarks = (marks ?? [])
		.map((mark) => (typeof mark === "number" ? { value: mark } : mark))
		.filter(
			(mark) =>
				Number.isFinite(mark.value) &&
				mark.value >= lower &&
				mark.value <= upper,
		)
		.map((mark) => ({ ...mark, value: round(mark.value) }))
		.sort((a, b) => a.value - b.value)
		.filter((mark, index, list) => mark.value !== list[index - 1]?.value);

	let ticks: number[] | null;
	if (normalizedMarks.length) {
		ticks = normalizedMarks.map((mark) => mark.value);
	} else if (span / safeStep <= MAX_TICKED_STEPS) {
		ticks = null;
	} else {
		// Long ranges tick on every 10% instead of every step.
		ticks = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, index) =>
			snap(lower + ((index + 1) * span) / 10),
		);
	}

	return {
		lower,
		upper,
		step: safeStep,
		decimals,
		ticks,
		marks: normalizedMarks,
		round,
		snap,
		stepFrom,
		fractionOf: (value) => (span > 0 ? clamp((value - lower) / span, 0, 1) : 0),
	};
}

function Readout({
	value,
	text,
	formatted,
	decimals,
	animated,
}: {
	value: number;
	text: string;
	formatted: boolean;
	decimals: number;
	animated: boolean;
}) {
	// A custom `format` returns a string, which can't roll digit by digit.
	if (formatted) return <span>{text}</span>;
	return (
		<NumberFlow
			value={value}
			locales="en-US"
			format={{
				minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
				maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
				useGrouping: false,
			}}
			animated={animated}
			respectMotionPreference={false}
			transformTiming={digitTiming}
			spinTiming={digitTiming}
		/>
	);
}

export function ElasticSlider({
	label,
	hideLabel = false,
	value: valueProp,
	defaultValue,
	onValueChange,
	onValueCommit,
	min = 0,
	max = 100,
	step = 1,
	largeStep,
	marks,
	format,
	startIcon,
	endIcon,
	variant = "inline",
	size = "md",
	maxStretch = 10,
	sound = true,
	haptics = true,
	disabled = false,
	name,
	className,
	...props
}: ElasticSliderProps) {
	const sizeStyle = sizes[size];
	const inline = variant === "inline";
	const thin = inline ? sizeStyle.inlineThin : sizeStyle.thin;
	const thick = inline ? sizeStyle.inlineThick : sizeStyle.thick;
	const scale = buildScale(min, max, step, marks);
	const { lower, upper } = scale;
	const inactive = disabled || upper <= lower;
	const stretchLimit = Math.max(
		0,
		Number.isFinite(maxStretch) ? maxStretch : 0,
	);
	const bigStep =
		largeStep !== undefined && Number.isFinite(largeStep) && largeStep > 0
			? largeStep
			: Math.max(
					scale.step,
					Math.round((upper - lower) / 10 / scale.step) * scale.step,
				);

	const controlled = valueProp !== undefined;
	const [internalValue, setInternalValue] = useState(() =>
		scale.snap(valueProp ?? defaultValue ?? lower),
	);
	const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
	// A drag in progress wins over the `value` prop; it syncs on release.
	// Out-of-range values are clamped for display without calling `onValueChange`.
	const value = scale.snap(controlled && !dragging ? valueProp : internalValue);
	const valueText = format ? format(value) : value.toFixed(scale.decimals);

	const shouldReduceMotion = useReducedMotion() ?? false;
	const { trigger: haptic } = useWebHaptics();
	const { click: playClick, toggle: playToggle } = useTiks({
		// Sound stays on under reduced motion; only movement is reduced.
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});
	// The crisp theme's click is a touch brighter: it marks `min` and `max`.
	const { click: playBrightClick } = useTiks({
		theme: "crisp",
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});

	const labelId = useId();
	const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const rowRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const labelRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
	const readoutRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);

	// Position of the value along the track, 0 to 1.
	const fraction = useMotionValue(scale.fractionOf(value));
	// Px the track is stretched past an end: negative past `min`, positive past `max`.
	const stretch = useMotionValue(0);
	const thickness = useMotionValue<number>(thin);
	const trackWidth = useMotionValue(0);
	// 1 in left-to-right layouts, -1 in right-to-left ones.
	const direction = useMotionValue<number>(1);
	const [rtl, setRtl] = useState(false);
	const labelOpacity = useMotionValue(1);
	const readoutOpacity = useMotionValue(1);

	const fractionAnimationRef = useRef<AnimationPlaybackControls | null>(null);
	const stretchAnimationRef = useRef<AnimationPlaybackControls | null>(null);
	const valueRef = useRef(value);
	const lastCueAtRef = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
	const lastHapticAtRef = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
	const textBoxesRef = useRef({ label: 0, readout: 0 });
	const dragRef = useRef<{
		pointerId: number;
		active: boolean;
		originX: number;
		originY: number;
		startValue: number;
		overdragged: boolean;
	} | null>(null);

	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		valueRef.current = value;
	});

	// The track grows past whichever end is stretched; the fill follows it.
	const trackStart = useTransform(stretch, (s) => `${Math.min(s, 0)}px`);
	const trackEnd = useTransform(stretch, (s) => `${-Math.max(s, 0)}px`);
	const trackHeight = useTransform(thickness, (h) => `${h}px`);
	const fillRatio = (f: number, s: number, width: number) =>
		width > 0 ? (f * width + Math.max(s, 0)) / (width + Math.abs(s)) : f;
	// The fill is a full-width layer slid along the track, so it moves with transforms only.
	const fillX = useTransform(
		() =>
			`${direction.get() * (fillRatio(fraction.get(), stretch.get(), trackWidth.get()) - 1) * 100}%`,
	);
	const fillContentX = useTransform(
		() =>
			`${direction.get() * (1 - fillRatio(fraction.get(), stretch.get(), trackWidth.get())) * 100}%`,
	);
	const startIconX = useTransform(
		() => direction.get() * Math.min(stretch.get(), 0),
	);
	const endIconX = useTransform(
		() => direction.get() * Math.max(stretch.get(), 0),
	);
	const startIconScale = useTransform(stretch, (s) =>
		stretchLimit > 0 ? 1 + (ICON_SCALE * Math.max(-s, 0)) / stretchLimit : 1,
	);
	const endIconScale = useTransform(stretch, (s) =>
		stretchLimit > 0 ? 1 + (ICON_SCALE * Math.max(s, 0)) / stretchLimit : 1,
	);

	/** Inline text fades out while the fill's edge passes through it. */
	const updateTextFade = useCallback(() => {
		if (!inline) return;
		const width = trackWidth.get();
		if (width <= 0) return;
		const s = stretch.get();
		const edge = fraction.get() * width + Math.max(s, 0);
		const total = width + Math.abs(s);
		const { padding } = sizeStyle;
		const fade = (from: number, to: number) => {
			if (to <= from) return 1;
			const distance = Math.max(from - edge, edge - to, 0);
			return clamp(distance / TEXT_FADE_PX, 0, 1);
		};
		const { label: labelWidth, readout: readoutWidth } = textBoxesRef.current;
		labelOpacity.set(fade(padding - 4, padding + labelWidth + 4));
		readoutOpacity.set(
			fade(total - padding - readoutWidth - 4, total - padding + 4),
		);
	}, [
		inline,
		sizeStyle,
		trackWidth,
		stretch,
		fraction,
		labelOpacity,
		readoutOpacity,
	]);

	useMotionValueEvent(fraction, "change", updateTextFade);
	useMotionValueEvent(stretch, "change", updateTextFade);
	useMotionValueEvent(trackWidth, "change", updateTextFade);

	// One observer measures the track and the inline text, so a resize mid-drag stays in step.
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		const row = rowRef.current;
		const root = rootRef.current;
		if (!row || !root) return;
		const measure = () => {
			const isRtl = getComputedStyle(root).direction === "rtl";
			direction.set(isRtl ? -1 : 1);
			setRtl(isRtl);
			textBoxesRef.current = {
				label: labelRef.current?.offsetWidth ?? 0,
				readout: readoutRef.current?.offsetWidth ?? 0,
			};
			trackWidth.set(row.offsetWidth);
			updateTextFade();
		};
		measure();
		const observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		observer.observe(row);
		if (labelRef.current) observer.observe(labelRef.current);
		if (readoutRef.current) observer.observe(readoutRef.current);
		return () => observer.disconnect();
	}, [direction, trackWidth, updateTextFade]);

	const moveFraction = useCallback(
		(target: number, transition: "jump" | "drag" | "soft") => {
			fractionAnimationRef.current?.stop();
			fractionAnimationRef.current = null;
			if (shouldReduceMotion || transition === "jump") {
				fraction.jump(target);
				return;
			}
			if (fraction.get() === target) return;
			fractionAnimationRef.current = animate(
				fraction,
				target,
				transition === "drag" ? dragSpring : softSpring,
			);
		},
		[fraction, shouldReduceMotion],
	);

	const releaseStretch = useCallback(() => {
		stretchAnimationRef.current?.stop();
		stretchAnimationRef.current = null;
		if (shouldReduceMotion) {
			stretch.jump(0);
			return;
		}
		if (stretch.get() === 0) return;
		// Springs carry the stretch's current velocity, so a release keeps its momentum.
		stretchAnimationRef.current = animate(stretch, 0, softSpring);
	}, [shouldReduceMotion, stretch]);

	const setThick = useCallback(
		(active: boolean) => {
			const target = active ? thick : thin;
			if (shouldReduceMotion) thickness.jump(target);
			else animate(thickness, target, softSpring);
		},
		[shouldReduceMotion, thick, thin, thickness],
	);

	useEffect(() => {
		if (!dragRef.current?.active) setThick(false);
	}, [setThick]);

	// The fill follows the value; drags move it themselves.
	const targetFraction = scale.fractionOf(value);
	useEffect(() => {
		if (dragRef.current?.active) return;
		moveFraction(targetFraction, "soft");
	}, [targetFraction, moveFraction]);

	useEffect(
		() => () => {
			fractionAnimationRef.current?.stop();
			stretchAnimationRef.current?.stop();
		},
		[],
	);

	useEffect(() => {
		if (shouldReduceMotion) stretch.jump(0);
	}, [shouldReduceMotion, stretch]);

	const silent = () =>
		typeof document !== "undefined" && document.visibilityState === "hidden";

	const vibrate = (pattern: "selection" | "rigid" | "light") => {
		if (!haptics) return;
		lastHapticAtRef.current = performance.now();
		void haptic(pattern);
	};

	const thunk = () => {
		if (silent()) return;
		if (sound) playToggle(false);
		vibrate("rigid");
	};

	// Called only for user input, so first render and prop changes stay quiet.
	const cue = (previous: number, next: number) => {
		if (previous === next || silent()) return;
		const now = performance.now();
		// The ends always sound, a little brighter, so a fast drag still lands on them.
		if (next === lower || next === upper) {
			lastCueAtRef.current = now;
			if (sound) playBrightClick();
			vibrate("selection");
			return;
		}
		const { ticks } = scale;
		const crossed =
			ticks === null ||
			ticks.some((tick) =>
				next > previous
					? tick > previous && tick <= next
					: tick < previous && tick >= next,
			);
		if (!crossed || now - lastCueAtRef.current < CUE_THROTTLE_MS) return;
		lastCueAtRef.current = now;
		if (sound) playClick();
		vibrate("selection");
	};

	const commit = (next: number) => {
		onValueCommit?.(next);
		// A tick's haptic already confirmed this change; don't double up.
		if (performance.now() - lastHapticAtRef.current > CUE_THROTTLE_MS) {
			if (!silent()) vibrate("light");
		}
	};

	const setValue = (next: number) => {
		const previous = valueRef.current;
		if (next === previous) return false;
		valueRef.current = next;
		setInternalValue(next);
		onValueChange?.(next);
		cue(previous, next);
		return true;
	};

	/** A tiny one-shot stretch past an end, for keys pressed at a limit. */
	const bump = (towards: Direction) => {
		thunk();
		if (shouldReduceMotion || stretchLimit <= 0) return;
		stretchAnimationRef.current?.stop();
		const controls = animate(stretch, towards * stretchLimit * BUMP_STRETCH, {
			duration: 0.08,
			ease: "easeOut",
		});
		stretchAnimationRef.current = controls;
		void controls.then(() => {
			if (stretchAnimationRef.current === controls) releaseStretch();
		});
	};

	const isRtl = () => {
		const root = rootRef.current;
		const next = root ? getComputedStyle(root).direction === "rtl" : false;
		direction.set(next ? -1 : 1);
		setRtl(next);
		return next;
	};

	/** The pointer's position along the track, in local px from the start edge. */
	const pointerOffset = (clientX: number) => {
		const row = rowRef.current;
		if (!row) return { offset: 0, width: 0 };
		const rect = row.getBoundingClientRect();
		const width = row.offsetWidth;
		// CSS zoom and transforms scale client coordinates; work in local px.
		const ratio = rect.width / (width || 1) || 1;
		const fromLeft = (clientX - rect.left) / ratio;
		return {
			offset: direction.get() < 0 ? width - fromLeft : fromLeft,
			width,
		};
	};

	const valueAtOffset = (offset: number, width: number) => {
		const f = width > 0 ? clamp(offset / width, 0, 1) : 0;
		const raw = lower + f * (upper - lower);
		// Within a few px of a mark, the value sticks to it.
		for (const mark of scale.marks) {
			if (
				Math.abs(scale.fractionOf(mark.value) * width - f * width) <=
				MARK_STICK_PX
			) {
				return mark.value;
			}
		}
		return scale.snap(raw);
	};

	const stepPx = () =>
		(trackWidth.get() * scale.step) / Math.max(upper - lower, scale.step);

	/** Moves to the pointer: sets the value, the fill, and any stretch past the ends. */
	const followPointer = (clientX: number, jumped: boolean) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		const { offset, width } = pointerOffset(clientX);
		const next = valueAtOffset(offset, width);
		setValue(next);
		const onMark = scale.marks.some((mark) => mark.value === next);
		const transition = jumped
			? "soft"
			: onMark || stepPx() > 3
				? "drag"
				: "jump";
		moveFraction(scale.fractionOf(next), transition);

		const over = offset < 0 ? offset : offset > width ? offset - width : 0;
		if (drag) {
			if (Math.abs(over) >= OVERDRAG_THUNK_PX) {
				// One thunk per pull past an end, not one per move.
				if (!drag.overdragged) thunk();
				drag.overdragged = true;
			} else if (over === 0) {
				drag.overdragged = false;
			}
		}
		if (shouldReduceMotion) return;
		stretchAnimationRef.current?.stop();
		stretchAnimationRef.current = null;
		stretch.set(Math.sign(over) * resist(Math.abs(over), stretchLimit));
	};

	const activate = (clientX: number) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		if (!drag || drag.active) return;
		drag.active = true;
		setDragging(true);
		setThick(true);
		followPointer(clientX, true);
	};

	const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		// Ignore second fingers and non-primary buttons.
		if (inactive || !event.isPrimary || event.button !== 0 || dragRef.current) {
			return;
		}
		isRtl();
		event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		dragRef.current = {
			pointerId: event.pointerId,
			active: false,
			originX: event.clientX,
			originY: event.clientY,
			startValue: valueRef.current,
			overdragged: false,
		};
		// A touch might be the start of a vertical page scroll; wait until it moves sideways or lifts.
		if (event.pointerType !== "touch") activate(event.clientX);
	};

	const handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		if (!drag.active) {
			const dx = Math.abs(event.clientX - drag.originX);
			const dy = Math.abs(event.clientY - drag.originY);
			if (dx < TOUCH_SLOP || dx < dy) return;
			activate(event.clientX);
			return;
		}
		followPointer(event.clientX, false);
	};

	const endDrag = (
		event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>,
		reason: "up" | "cancel",
	) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		// A lifted tap counts as a click; a cancelled touch was a page scroll.
		if (!drag.active && reason === "up") activate(event.clientX);
		dragRef.current = null;
		const row = rowRef.current;
		if (row?.hasPointerCapture(drag.pointerId)) {
			row.releasePointerCapture(drag.pointerId);
		}
		if (!drag.active) return;
		setDragging(false);
		setThick(false);
		releaseStretch();
		moveFraction(scale.fractionOf(valueRef.current), "soft");
		if (valueRef.current !== drag.startValue) commit(valueRef.current);
	};

	const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (inactive) return;
		// Left and right follow the reading direction, like a native range input.
		const forward: Direction = isRtl() ? -1 : 1;
		const from = valueRef.current;
		const by = (towards: Direction): [number, Direction] => [
			event.shiftKey
				? scale.snap(from + towards * bigStep)
				: scale.stepFrom(from, towards),
			towards,
		];
		const moves: Record<string, () => [number, Direction]> = {
			ArrowUp: () => by(1),
			ArrowDown: () => by(-1),
			ArrowRight: () => by(forward),
			ArrowLeft: () => by(-forward as Direction),
			PageUp: () => [scale.snap(from + bigStep), 1],
			PageDown: () => [scale.snap(from - bigStep), -1],
			Home: () => [lower, -1],
			End: () => [upper, 1],
		};
		const move = moves[event.key];
		if (!move) return;
		event.preventDefault();
		const [target, towards] = move();

	useRef,

const DAY = 1440;
const HOUR = 60;

const snapSpring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 600, damping: 40 } as const;
const digitTiming = {
	duration: 450,
	easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)",
} as const;

/** Hour clicks and limit thunks: the same tiks sounds, a little lower. */
const deepTheme = defineTheme({
	name: "time-ring-deep",
	baseFreq: 300,
	filterFreq: 1400,
	filterQ: 1.4,
	decay: 1.5,
});

/** The dial is drawn on a 200 x 200 grid and scales to its container. */
const VIEW = 200;
const CENTER = VIEW / 2;
const TRACK_WIDTH = 24;
const TRACK_RADIUS = CENTER - TRACK_WIDTH / 2 - 1;
const ARC_WIDTH = TRACK_WIDTH - 3;
const HANDLE_SIZE = ARC_WIDTH - 3;
const TICK_OUTER = TRACK_RADIUS - TRACK_WIDTH / 2 - 4;
const LABEL_RADIUS = TICK_OUTER - 18;
/** Extra reach, in grid units, around the track and handles for presses. */
const HIT_SLOP = 8;
const HANDLE_HIT = HANDLE_SIZE / 2 + HIT_SLOP;
/** Pointer travel, in px, before a press becomes a drag. */
const DRAG_SLOP = 3;
/** Extra travel, in steps, before a drag leaves its current step. */
const HYSTERESIS = 0.08;
/** Minimum ms between step sounds and haptics. */
const CUE_THROTTLE_MS = 35;

const sizes = {
	sm: 240,
	md: 288,
	lg: 336,
} as const;

const steps = [5, 15, 30] as const;

type Part = "start" | "end";
type DragPart = Part | "arc";

export interface TimeRingValue {
	/** Minutes from midnight, 0 to 1439. */
	start: number;
	/** Minutes from midnight, 0 to 1439. Before `start` means the next day. */
	end: number;
}

export interface TimeRingProps {
	/** Controlled range, in minutes from midnight. */
	value?: TimeRingValue;
	/** Initial range when uncontrolled. */
	defaultValue?: TimeRingValue;
	/** Called every time either end lands on a new step. */
	onValueChange?: (value: TimeRingValue) => void;
	/** Minutes each end snaps to. */
	step?: (typeof steps)[number];
	/** Shortest range in minutes. Defaults to one `step`. */
	minDuration?: number;
	/** Longest range in minutes. Defaults to a day less one `step`. */
	maxDuration?: number;
	/** Clock used for the times, labels, and `aria-valuetext`. */
	format?: "12h" | "24h";
	/** Icon on the start handle. */
	startIcon?: ReactNode;
	/** Icon on the end handle. */
	endIcon?: ReactNode;
	/** Accessible name of the start handle, also used in its `aria-valuetext`. */
	startLabel?: string;
	/** Accessible name of the end handle, also used in its `aria-valuetext`. */
	endLabel?: string;
	/** Play a tick per step, a deeper click per hour, and a thunk at the limits. */
	sound?: boolean;
	/** Trigger haptics on supported devices. */
	haptics?: boolean;
	/** Largest diameter. The ring shrinks to fit narrower containers. */
	size?: keyof typeof sizes;
	disabled?: boolean;

	"aria-labelledby"?: string;
	className?: string;

	return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

/** Wraps minutes into 0..1439. */
function wrapDay(minutes: number) {
	return ((minutes % DAY) + DAY) % DAY;
}

/** Wraps a minute difference into -720..719. */
function wrapDelta(minutes: number) {
	return wrapDay(minutes + DAY / 2) - DAY / 2;
}

function durationOf({ start, end }: TimeRingValue) {
	return wrapDay(end - start);

/** A point on a circle around the center, clockwise from midnight at the top. */

					/>

						name={`${name}[end]`}
						value={value.end}
						disabled={disabled}
					/>
				</>
			) : null}
		</div>
	);

	md: { rowHeight: 40, text: "text-base", padding: "px-4" },

	value: string;

	rowHeight: number;

	/** Radians per row. */

	loop: boolean,
	rowHeight: number,
	visibleCount: number,
	flat: boolean,

		timer?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;

	const dragRef = useRef<{
		pointerId: number;
		startY: number;
		startPosition: number;
		scale: number;
		moved: boolean;
		wasMoving: boolean;
		samples: { t: number; p: number }[];
	} | null>(null);

	const wrap = (row: number) => (looping ? mod(row, count) : row);
	const isEnabled = (row: number) => {
		const index = wrap(row);
		return index >= 0 && index < count && !options[index].disabled;
	};
	const quiet = () =>
		typeof document !== "undefined" && document.visibilityState === "hidden";

	/** Closest enabled row to a resting point. */
	const nearestEnabled = (point: number) => {
		const anchor = looping ? point : clamp(point, firstEnabled, lastEnabled);
		const centre = Math.round(anchor);
		for (let step = 0; step <= count; step++) {
			const below = centre - step;
			const above = centre + step;
			const pair =
				Math.abs(below - anchor) <= Math.abs(above - anchor)
					? [below, above]
					: [above, below];
			for (const row of pair) if (isEnabled(row)) return row;
		}
		return centre;
	};

	/** Moves `rows` rows in `direction`, then on to the next enabled row. */
	const stepEnabled = (from: number, direction: number, rows: number) => {
		let start = from + direction * rows;
		if (!looping) start = clamp(start, firstEnabled, lastEnabled);
		for (let step = 0; step < count; step++) {
			const row = start + direction * step;
			if (!looping && (row < firstEnabled || row > lastEnabled)) break;
			if (isEnabled(row)) return row;
		}
		for (let step = 1; step < count; step++) {
			const row = start - direction * step;
			if (direction * (row - from) <= 0) break;
			if (isEnabled(row)) return row;
		}
		return from;
	};

	/** The absolute row for `index` along the shortest way round. */
	const nearestRowFor = (index: number) => {
		if (!looping) return index;
		const base = Math.round(position.get());
		let delta = mod(index - base, count);
		if (delta > count / 2) delta -= count;
		return base + delta;
	};

	const setPhase = (phase: Phase) => {
		phaseRef.current = phase;
		if (rootRef.current) rootRef.current.dataset.state = phase;
	};

	// Rows are drawn imperatively so drag and coast never re-render.
	const placeRows = (pos: number, all: boolean) => {
		const geo = geometryRef.current;
		const drumRows = drumRowRefs.current;
		const bandRows = bandRowRefs.current;
		const stamps = stampsRef.current;
		const generation = ++generationRef.current;
		const shown: number[] = [];
		const centre = Math.round(pos);
		const span = Math.ceil(geo.reach) * 2;
		// Nearest rows first, so a short looping list draws each row once.
		for (let step = 0; step <= span && geo.count; step++) {
			const row = centre + (step % 2 ? (step + 1) / 2 : -step / 2);
			const offset = row - pos;
			if (Math.abs(offset) > geo.reach) continue;
			const index = geo.loop ? mod(row, geo.count) : row;
			if (index < 0 || index >= geo.count || stamps[index] === generation) {
				continue;
			}
			stamps[index] = generation;
			shown.push(index);
			const transform = rowTransform(offset, geo);
			const drumRow = drumRows[index];
			if (drumRow) {
				drumRow.style.transform = transform;
				drumRow.style.opacity = rowOpacity(offset, geo);
				drumRow.style.visibility = "";
				drumRow.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
			}
			const bandRow = bandRows[index];
			if (bandRow) {
				const inBand = Math.abs(offset) < 1;
				bandRow.style.visibility = inBand ? "" : "hidden";
				if (inBand) bandRow.style.transform = transform;
			}
		}
		// The selected option stays in the accessibility tree for
		// aria-activedescendant, even while a long jump carries it off the drum.
		const selected = selectedRef.current;
		if (
			selected >= 0 &&
			selected < geo.count &&
			stamps[selected] !== generation
		) {
			stamps[selected] = generation;
			shown.push(selected);
			const drumRow = drumRows[selected];
			if (drumRow) {
				drumRow.style.visibility = "";
				drumRow.style.opacity = "0";
				drumRow.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
			}
			const bandRow = bandRows[selected];
			if (bandRow) bandRow.style.visibility = "hidden";
		}
		const previous = all ? drumRows.map((_, index) => index) : shownRef.current;
		for (const index of previous) {
			if (stamps[index] === generation) continue;
			const drumRow = drumRows[index];
			if (drumRow) {
				drumRow.style.visibility = "hidden";
				drumRow.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
			}
			const bandRow = bandRows[index];
			if (bandRow) bandRow.style.visibility = "hidden";
		}
		shownRef.current = shown;
	};

	const cueTick = () => {
		if (quiet()) return;
		const now = performance.now();
		// Ticks that come too fast are dropped, never queued, like a ratchet.
		if (sound && now - lastTickAtRef.current >= TICK_THROTTLE_MS) {
			lastTickAtRef.current = now;
			playClick();
		}
		if (haptics && now - lastHapticAtRef.current >= HAPTIC_THROTTLE_MS) {
			lastHapticAtRef.current = now;
			void haptic("selection");
		}
	};

	const cueSettle = () => {
		if (quiet()) return;
		if (sound) playPop();
		if (haptics) void haptic("light");
	};

	const cueEdge = (over: boolean) => {
		if (over && !overEdgeRef.current && haptics && !quiet()) {
			void haptic("rigid");
		}
		overEdgeRef.current = over;
	};

	// The one place that reacts to movement: rows, ticks, and onScrollValue.
	const sync = (pos: number) => {
		placeRows(pos, false);
		if (!count) return;
		const centre = looping
			? Math.round(pos)
			: clamp(Math.round(pos), 0, count - 1);
		if (normalizingRef.current) {
			centreRef.current = centre;
			return;
		}
		const previous = centreRef.current;
		if (centre === previous) return;
		centreRef.current = centre;
		if (sourceRef.current !== "user") return;
		crossedRef.current = true;
		if (onScrollValue) {
			const direction = Math.sign(centre - previous);
			const crossed = Math.min(Math.abs(centre - previous), count);
			for (let step = crossed - 1; step >= 0; step--) {
				const option = options[wrap(centre - direction * step)];
				if (option && !option.disabled) onScrollValue(option.value);
			}
		}
		cueTick();
	};

	const stopAnimation = () => {
		animationRef.current?.stop();
		animationRef.current = null;
		cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
	};

	const resetWheel = () => {
		clearTimeout(wheelRef.current.timer);
		wheelRef.current.active = false;
	};

	const commit = (row: number) => {
		const option = options[wrap(row)];
		if (!option || option.disabled) return;
		if (!controlled) setInternalValue(option.value);
		// Re-render even when unchanged, so a parent that ignores the change
		// pulls the wheel back to its value.
		forceRender();
		if (option.value === reportedRef.current) return;
		reportedRef.current = option.value;
		onValueChange?.(option.value);
	};

	const moveTo = (
		target: number,
		{
			silent = false,
			velocity = 0,
			mode = "spring",
			commitOnDone = true,
			cue = false,
		}: MoveOptions = {},
	) => {
		stopAnimation();
		resetWheel();
		targetRef.current = target;
		sourceRef.current = silent ? "program" : "user";
		const done = () => {
			animationRef.current = null;
			if (!mountedRef.current) return;
			setPhase("idle");
			// Keep a looping wheel's position near zero; the rows look the same.
			const wrapped = wrap(target);
			if (wrapped !== target) {
				normalizingRef.current = true;
				position.jump(wrapped);
				normalizingRef.current = false;
				targetRef.current = wrapped;
			}
			if (silent) return;
			if (cue && crossedRef.current) cueSettle();
			if (commitOnDone) commit(target);
			else forceRender();
		};
		if (mode === "instant" || position.get() === target) {
			position.jump(target);
			done();
			return;
		}
		setPhase("settling");
		animationRef.current = animate(
			position,
			target,
			mode === "ease"
				? { ...reducedSnap, onComplete: done }
				: { ...settleSpring, velocity, onComplete: done },
		);
	};

	/** Milliseconds over which coasting speed falls by a factor of e. */
	const decayMs = -16 / Math.log(friction);

	const settleNear = (point: number, velocity = 0) => {
		moveTo(nearestEnabled(point), {
			velocity,
			mode: shouldReduceMotion ? "ease" : "spring",
			cue: true,
		});
	};

	const coast = (initial: number) => {
		setPhase("coasting");
		targetRef.current = null;
		let velocity = initial;
		let last = performance.now();
		const step = (now: number) => {
			const elapsed = Math.min(now - last, 50);
			last = now;
			const decay = friction ** (elapsed / 16);
			// Exact distance covered by exponential friction over the frame.
			const next = position.get() + velocity * decayMs * (1 - decay);
			velocity *= decay;
			if (!looping && (next < firstEnabled || next > lastEnabled)) {
				// Hit an end: bounce off it with a capped speed.
				const edge = next < firstEnabled ? firstEnabled : lastEnabled;
				position.set(edge);
				cueEdge(true);
				moveTo(edge, {
					velocity: clamp(velocity * 1000, -EDGE_SPEED, EDGE_SPEED),
					cue: true,
				});
				return;
			}
			position.set(next);
			if (Math.abs(velocity) * 1000 < SNAP_SPEED) {
				settleNear(next + velocity * decayMs, velocity * 1000);
				return;
			}
			frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
		};
		frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
	};

	const release = (velocity: number) => {
		const pos = position.get();
		if (shouldReduceMotion) {
			settleNear(pos);
			return;
		}
		const limit = MAX_VELOCITY_PX / rowHeight / 1000;
		const capped = clamp(velocity, -limit, limit);
		if (!looping && (pos < firstEnabled || pos > lastEnabled)) {
			settleNear(pos);
			return;
		}
		if (Math.abs(capped) * 1000 < SNAP_SPEED) {
			settleNear(pos + capped * decayMs, capped * 1000);
			return;
		}
		coast(capped);
	};

	const scrollTo = (raw: number) => {
		if (looping) {
			position.set(raw);
			return;
		}
		cueEdge(raw < firstEnabled || raw > lastEnabled);
		position.set(rubberBand(raw, firstEnabled, lastEnabled, visibleCount / 4));
	};

	/** Row under a point `y` px from the drum centre. */
	const rowAt = (y: number) => {
		const pos = position.get();
		const centre = Math.round(pos);
		const reach = Math.ceil(geometry.reach);
		let best: number | null = null;
		let bestDistance = rowHeight;
		for (let row = centre - reach; row <= centre + reach; row++) {
			const offset = row - pos;
			if (Math.abs(offset) > geometry.reach) continue;
			if (!looping && (row < 0 || row >= count)) continue;
			const distance = Math.abs(projectY(offset, geometry) - y);
			if (distance < bestDistance) {
				best = row;
				bestDistance = distance;
			}
		}
		return best;
	};

	const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (!interactive || event.button !== 0) return;
		const root = event.currentTarget;
		root.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		root.focus({ preventScroll: true });
		const wasMoving = phaseRef.current !== "idle";
		// Touching a moving wheel stops it under the finger.
		stopAnimation();
		resetWheel();
		if (wasMoving) {
			targetRef.current = null;
			setPhase("idle");
		}
		sourceRef.current = "user";
		crossedRef.current = false;
		overEdgeRef.current = false;
		const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
		// CSS zoom and transforms scale client coordinates; work in local px.
		const scale = rect.height / (root.offsetHeight || 1) || 1;
		dragRef.current = {
			pointerId: event.pointerId,
			startY: event.clientY,
			startPosition: position.get(),
			scale,
			moved: false,
			wasMoving,
			samples: [{ t: event.timeStamp, p: position.get() }],
		};
	};

	const handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		const delta = (event.clientY - drag.startY) / drag.scale;
		if (!drag.moved) {
			if (Math.abs(delta) < TAP_SLOP) return;
			drag.moved = true;
			targetRef.current = null;
			setPhase("dragging");
		}
		const raw = drag.startPosition - delta / rowHeight;
		drag.samples.push({ t: event.timeStamp, p: raw });
		while (
			drag.samples.length > 2 &&
			event.timeStamp - drag.samples[0].t > VELOCITY_WINDOW_MS
		) {
			drag.samples.shift();
		}
		scrollTo(raw);
	};

	const handlePointerUp = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		dragRef.current = null;
		const root = event.currentTarget;
		if (root.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
			root.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		}

		if (!drag.moved) {
			if (drag.wasMoving) {
				settleNear(position.get());
				return;
			}
			// Tap: scroll the tapped row to the centre.
			const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
			const y = (event.clientY - rect.top) / drag.scale - root.offsetHeight / 2;
			const row = rowAt(y);
			if (row === null || !isEnabled(row) || row === targetRef.current) {
				return;
			}
			moveTo(row, { mode: shouldReduceMotion ? "ease" : "spring", cue: true });
			return;
		}

		const recent = drag.samples.filter(
			(sample) => event.timeStamp - sample.t <= VELOCITY_WINDOW_MS,
		);
		const first = recent[0];
		const last = recent[recent.length - 1];
		// A finger that stopped before lifting releases with no speed.
		const held = !last || event.timeStamp - last.t > VELOCITY_WINDOW_MS / 2;
		const velocity =
			held || recent.length < 2 || last.t === first.t
				? 0
				: (last.p - first.p) / (last.t - first.t);
		release(velocity);
	};

	const handlePointerCancel = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (dragRef.current?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		dragRef.current = null;
		settleNear(position.get());
	};

	const typeahead = (key: string, base: number) => {
		const search = typeaheadRef.current;
		clearTimeout(search.timer);
		search.text += key.toLowerCase();
		search.timer = setTimeout(() => {
			search.text = "";
		}, TYPEAHEAD_RESET_MS);
		const from = wrap(base);
		const find = (query: string, skip: number) => {
			for (let step = skip; step < count + skip; step++) {
				const index = mod(from + step, count);
				const option = options[index];
				if (
					!option.disabled &&
					textOf(option).toLowerCase().startsWith(query)
				) {
					return looping ? base + mod(index - from, count) : index;
				}
			}
			return null;
		};
		const { text } = search;
		const found = find(text, text.length === 1 ? 1 : 0);
		if (found !== null) return found;
		// Repeating one letter cycles through the options that start with it.
		const repeated = text.split("").every((char) => char === text[0]);
		return repeated ? find(text[0], 1) : null;
	};

	const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (!interactive || dragRef.current) return;
		// Repeated keys build on the pending target, not the moving wheel.
		const base = targetRef.current ?? nearestEnabled(position.get());
		let target: number | null = null;
		switch (event.key) {
			case "ArrowUp":
				target = stepEnabled(base, -1, 1);
				break;
			case "ArrowDown":
				target = stepEnabled(base, 1, 1);
				break;
			case "PageUp":
				target = stepEnabled(base, -1, visibleCount);
				break;
			case "PageDown":
				target = stepEnabled(base, 1, visibleCount);
				break;
			case "Home":
				target = nearestRowFor(firstEnabled);
				break;
			case "End":
				target = nearestRowFor(lastEnabled);
				break;
			default: {
				const printable =
					event.key.length === 1 &&
					!event.ctrlKey &&
					!event.metaKey &&
					!event.altKey;
				if (!printable) return;
				if (event.key === " " && !typeaheadRef.current.text) return;
				target = typeahead(event.key, base);
			}
		}
		event.preventDefault();
		if (target === null) return;
		if (target === base && phaseRef.current === "idle") return;
		crossedRef.current = false;
		moveTo(target, {
			mode: shouldReduceMotion ? "instant" : "spring",
			commitOnDone: false,
		});
		commit(target);
	};

	const handleWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
		if (!interactive) return;
		// Sideways scrolling belongs to the page.
		if (Math.abs(event.deltaX) > Math.abs(event.deltaY) || !event.deltaY) {
			return;
		}
		event.preventDefault();
		if (dragRef.current) return;
		const wheel = wheelRef.current;
		const notch =
			event.deltaMode !== 0 || Math.abs(event.deltaY) >= WHEEL_NOTCH_PX;
		if (notch && !wheel.active) {
			// One notch, one row.
			const base = targetRef.current ?? nearestEnabled(position.get());
			const target = stepEnabled(base, Math.sign(event.deltaY), 1);
			if (target === base) return;
			moveTo(target, { mode: shouldReduceMotion ? "instant" : "spring" });
			return;
		}
		if (!wheel.active) {
			stopAnimation();
			wheel.active = true;
			wheel.raw = position.get();
			targetRef.current = null;
			sourceRef.current = "user";
			crossedRef.current = false;
			overEdgeRef.current = false;
			setPhase("scrolling");
		}
		// Trackpads scroll like a drag and settle once the deltas stop.
		wheel.raw += event.deltaY / rowHeight;
		scrollTo(wheel.raw);
		clearTimeout(wheel.timer);
		wheel.timer = setTimeout(() => settleNear(position.get()), WHEEL_IDLE_MS);
	};

	// Imperative listeners call through refs so they always see the latest render.
	const syncRef = useRef(sync);
	const wheelHandlerRef = useRef(handleWheel);
	const moveToRef = useRef(moveTo);
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		syncRef.current = sync;
		wheelHandlerRef.current = handleWheel;
		moveToRef.current = moveTo;
		geometryRef.current = geometry;
		selectedRef.current = selectedIndex;
		reportedRef.current = options[selectedIndex]?.value;
		// React may have rewritten row styles; redraw them from the motion value.
		placeRows(position.get(), true);

		// Follow the value prop silently, unless the user holds the wheel.
		const previous = syncedRef.current;
		syncedRef.current = selectedIndex;
		if (selectedIndex < 0 || dragRef.current) return;
		const target = targetRef.current;
		if (target !== null && wrap(target) === selectedIndex) return;
		// A gesture in flight keeps going unless the value prop changed.
		if (phaseRef.current !== "idle" && selectedIndex === previous) return;
		moveTo(nearestRowFor(selectedIndex), {
			silent: true,
			mode: shouldReduceMotion ? "instant" : "spring",
		});
	});

	useEffect(
		() => position.on("change", (latest) => syncRef.current(latest)),
		[position],
	);

	useEffect(() => {
		mountedRef.current = true;
		const wheel = wheelRef.current;
		const search = typeaheadRef.current;
		return () => {
			mountedRef.current = false;
			animationRef.current?.stop();
			cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
			clearTimeout(wheel.timer);
			clearTimeout(search.timer);
		};
	}, []);

	// Wheel needs a non-passive listener to keep the page from scrolling, and
	// only fires while the pointer is over the wheel.
	useEffect(() => {
		const root = rootRef.current;
		if (!root) return;
		const onWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => wheelHandlerRef.current(event);
		root.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { passive: false });
		return () => root.removeEventListener("wheel", onWheel);
	}, []);

	// iOS can still scroll the page under a captured pointer; block it mid-drag.
	useEffect(() => {
		const root = rootRef.current;
		if (!root) return;
		const onTouchMove = (event: TouchEvent) => {
			if (dragRef.current?.moved) event.preventDefault();
		};
		root.addEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove, { passive: false });
		return () => root.removeEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove);
	}, []);

	// Disabling mid-gesture settles the wheel where it is.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (interactive || phaseRef.current === "idle") return;
		dragRef.current = null;
		moveToRef.current(Math.round(position.get()), { silent: true });
	}, [interactive, position]);

	const bandTop = `calc(50% - ${rowHeight / 2}px)`;
	const fade = rowHeight / 2;
	// Fade the drum's ends and cut out the band, where the selection layer draws.
	const mask = `linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #000 ${fade}px, #000 ${bandTop}, transparent ${bandTop}, transparent calc(50% + ${rowHeight / 2}px), #000 calc(50% + ${rowHeight / 2}px), #000 calc(100% - ${fade}px), transparent)`;
	const optionId = (index: number) => `${id}-option-${index}`;

	// First paint, before effects take over the row styles.
	const initialStyle = (index: number, band: boolean): CSSProperties => {
		const offset = looping
			? index - restIndex - count * Math.round((index - restIndex) / count)
			: index - restIndex;
		const shown = band
			? Math.abs(offset) < 1
			: Math.abs(offset) <= geometry.reach;
		return {
			transform: rowTransform(offset, geometry),
			opacity: band ? undefined : rowOpacity(offset, geometry),
			visibility: shown ? undefined : "hidden",
		};
	};

	return (
		<div
			ref={rootRef}
			role="listbox"
			tabIndex={interactive ? 0 : -1}
			aria-label={ariaLabelledBy ? ariaLabel : (ariaLabel ?? "Value")}
			aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy}
			aria-activedescendant={
				selectedIndex >= 0 ? optionId(selectedIndex) : undefined
			}
			aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
			data-slot="wheel-picker"
			data-state="idle"
			data-size={size}
			data-disabled={disabled || undefined}
			onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
			onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
			onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
			onPointerCancel={handlePointerCancel}
			onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
			style={{ height: visibleCount * rowHeight }}
			className={cn(
				"relative inline-block min-w-12 shrink-0 cursor-grab touch-none select-none overflow-hidden rounded-md font-medium tabular-nums outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 data-[state=dragging]:cursor-grabbing data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:opacity-50",
				sizeStyle.text,
				classNames?.root,
				className,
			)}
		>
			{inGroup ? null : (
				<div
					aria-hidden
					data-slot="wheel-picker-highlight"
					className={cn(

"use client";

import { useTiks } from "@rexa-developer/tiks/react";
import {

	animate,
	motion,
	useIsPresent,
	useMotionValue,
	useReducedMotion,
} from "motion/react";
import {
	Children,
	isValidElement,
	type KeyboardEvent,
	type PointerEvent,
	type ReactElement,
	type ReactNode,
	type Ref,
	useCallback,
	useEffect,
	useLayoutEffect,
	useRef,
	useState,
} from "react";
import { useWebHaptics } from "web-haptics/react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** The shell's liquid morph between views. */
const shellSpring = { type: "spring", bounce: 0.3, duration: 0.55 } as const;
const shellReduced = { duration: 0.15, ease: "easeOut" } as const;
const pressSpring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 600, damping: 30 } as const;
const releaseSpring = { type: "spring", bounce: 0.3, duration: 0.45 } as const;

/** Corner radius of an expanded card, in px. */
const CARD_RADIUS = 28;
/** Size of the empty idle pill, in px. */
const IDLE_WIDTH = 120;
const IDLE_HEIGHT = 36;
/** Minimum ms between view-change sounds and haptics. */
const CUE_THROTTLE_MS = 80;
/** Ms after a tap, key, or swipe in which a view change counts as the user's. */
const USER_INTENT_MS = 1000;
/** Ms of quiet before the live region announces a new view. */
const ANNOUNCE_DELAY = 150;
/** Pointer travel, in px, before a press on an expanded view becomes a swipe. */
const DRAG_SLOP = 4;
/** Upward travel, in px, that dismisses an expanded view on release. */
const DISMISS_DISTANCE = 24;
/** Upward speed, in px/ms, that dismisses an expanded view as a flick. */
const FLICK_VELOCITY = 0.5;
/** Px the shell can stretch before the rubber band hits its limit. */
const RUBBER_LIMIT = 16;
/** Px of drag the rubber band resists against. */
const RUBBER_DIMENSION = 60;

const FOCUSABLE =
	'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';

const viewSizes = {
	compact:
		"flex min-h-9 min-w-30 items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3 py-1.5 font-medium text-sm",
	expanded: "flex w-80 max-w-full flex-col gap-3 p-4 text-sm",
} as const;

type Tier = "idle" | "compact" | "expanded";

export interface DynamicIslandProps {
	/** Id of the `DynamicIslandView` to show. `null` shows the idle pill. */
	view: string | null;
	/** Content of the pill while `view` is `null`. Omit it for an empty pill. */
	compact?: ReactNode;
	/** `DynamicIslandView` elements. */
	children?: ReactNode;
	/** Called when a compact view is tapped, with its id, or the idle pill with `null`. Makes them buttons. */
	onExpand?: (id: string | null) => void;
	/** Called on Escape, a click outside, or a swipe up on an expanded view. */
	onDismiss?: () => void;
	/** `top` fixes the island to the top centre of the viewport. */
	position?: "inline" | "top";
	/** Play a sound per view change. */
	sound?: boolean;
	/** Trigger haptics on supported devices. */
	haptics?: boolean;
	/** Mute sounds and haptics for view changes the user didn't cause. */
	quiet?: boolean;
	/** Let a swipe up dismiss an expanded view. */
	swipeToDismiss?: boolean;
	/** Accessible name of the idle pill when it is a button. */
	label?: string;
	/** Classes for the island shell. */
	className?: string;
	classNames?: { root?: string; content?: string };

export interface DynamicIslandViewProps {
	id: string;
	/** Text summary for screen readers, announced once each time the view opens. */
	label: string;
	/** `expanded` gives a card with 28px corners and a pop when it opens. */
	size?: "compact" | "expanded";

	silent?: boolean;
	className?: string;
	children?: ReactNode;

export function DynamicIslandView({
	id,
	size = "compact",
	className,
	children,
}: DynamicIslandViewProps) {

			data-size={size}
			className={cn(viewSizes[size], className)}

/** Soft resistance past a boundary. */
function rubberband(distance: number) {
	const constant = 0.55;
	return (
		(distance * RUBBER_DIMENSION * constant) /

function findView(children: ReactNode, id: string | null) {

	return null;

	reduceMotion: boolean;
	ariaHidden: boolean;
	className?: string;
	onSize: (width: number, height: number) => void;
	onNode: (node: HTMLDivElement | null) => void;
	children: ReactNode;
}

	compact,

	onDismiss,
	position = "inline",

	haptics = true,
	quiet = false,
	swipeToDismiss = true,
	label = "Status",
	className,
	classNames,
}: DynamicIslandProps) {

	const expandIntentAtRef = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);

		} else if (event.key === " ") {

			event.preventDefault();
		}

		if (!pressable || event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
		if (event.key === " ") expand();

			y.stop();

		<div
			data-slot="dynamic-island-root"
			data-position={position}
			className={cn(
				"@container flex justify-center",
				top

				ref={shellRef}
				data-slot="dynamic-island"
				data-tier={tier}
				data-view={activeId ?? undefined}
				role={pressable ? "button" : tier === "expanded" ? "region" : undefined}
				tabIndex={pressable ? 0 : -1}

				}

					...(size ? { width: size.width, height: size.height } : {}),
				}}
				transition={

						? { duration: 0 }
						: shouldReduceMotion

							: shellSpring

				style={{
					scale,
					y,
					borderRadius: radius,
					touchAction: swipeable ? "none" : undefined,
				}}
				onClick={() => {
					if (pressable) expand();
				}}
				// A swipe ends without clicking the button it started on.
				onClickCapture={(event) => {
					if (!suppressClickRef.current) return;
					suppressClickRef.current = false;
					event.preventDefault();
					event.stopPropagation();
				}}
				onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
				onKeyUp={handleKeyUp}
				onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
				onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
				onPointerUp={() => endDrag(false)}
				onPointerCancel={() => endDrag(true)}
				onPointerLeave={() => {
					if (!dragRef.current?.dragging) release();
				}}
				className={cn(
					"pointer-events-auto relative flex max-w-full select-none items-start justify-center overflow-hidden bg-foreground text-background shadow-sm outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background",
					pressable && "cursor-pointer",
					swipeable && "cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing",
					className,
				)}

				<AnimatePresence mode="popLayout" initial={false}>
					<IslandContent

export interface DynamicIslandShowOptions {
	/** Ms to show the view before returning to the previous one. Omit to keep it. */
	duration?: number;
}

type QueuedView = { key: number; id: string; duration: number };

/**
 * Drives a `DynamicIsland`. `show(id)` sets the resting view; with a

 * timed views first in, first out. `hide()` drops the timed view on screen,
 * or clears the resting view when none is queued.
 */
export function useDynamicIsland(initial: string | null = null) {

		base: string | null;
		queue: QueuedView[];
	}>({ base: initial, queue: [] });
	const keyRef = useRef(0);
	const head = state.queue[0];

	useEffect(() => {
		if (!head) return;
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			setState((current) =>
				current.queue[0]?.key === head.key
					? { ...current, queue: current.queue.slice(1) }
					: current,
			);
		}, head.duration);
		return () => clearTimeout(timer);
	}, [head]);

	const show = useCallback((id: string, options?: DynamicIslandShowOptions) => {
		const duration = options?.duration;
		if (duration === undefined) {
			setState((current) => ({ ...current, base: id }));
			return;
		}
		keyRef.current += 1;
		const entry = { key: keyRef.current, id, duration };
		setState((current) => ({ ...current, queue: [...current.queue, entry] }));
	}, []);

	const hide = useCallback(() => {
		setState((current) =>
			current.queue.length > 0
				? { ...current, queue: current.queue.slice(1) }
				: { ...current, base: null },
		);
	}, []);

	return { view: head ? head.id : state.base, show, hide };
}

			}

		drag.raw = clamp(

		const over = drag.raw < 0 ? drag.raw : drag.raw > 1 ? drag.raw - 1 : 0;

		// A new detent moves the pointer through the effect; otherwise only the band moved.
		if (!moveTo(indexAt(drag.raw, indexRef.current), false)) {

		}

			case "ArrowLeft":

			case "PageDown":

			case "Home":

} from "motion/react";

	type MouseEvent,

	useRef,

const pressSpring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 600, damping: 30 } as const;

const FILL_MS = 150;
/** Ms between stars rising on a higher pick. */
const RISE_STAGGER_MS = 35;
/** Ms between stars draining on a clear. */
const DRAIN_STAGGER_MS = 25;
/** Minimum ms between star sounds and haptics. */
const CUE_THROTTLE_MS = 35;
/** Px a touch travels before it counts as a sweep or a scroll. */
const TOUCH_SLOP = 8;
/** Most stars a row can hold. */
const MAX_STARS = 10;

	sm: { cell: "w-6", star: "size-5", caption: "text-xs" },
	md: { cell: "w-8", star: "size-7", caption: "text-sm" },
	lg: { cell: "w-10", star: "size-9", caption: "text-base" },
} as const;

type Gesture = {
	pointerId: number;
	touch: boolean;
	startX: number;
	startY: number;
	/** Value when the press began. */
	start: number;
	/** Value under the pointer when it went down. */
	pressed: number;
	/** Value the drag currently shows. */
	current: number;
	/** Touch waits for `TOUCH_SLOP` px of travel to tell a sweep from a scroll. */

	sweeping: boolean;

	value?: number;
	/** Initial value when uncontrolled. */
	defaultValue?: number;
	/** Called on every change, including each step of a sweep. */
	onValueChange?: (value: number) => void;

		// The ratio is rounded first so 0.175 / 0.05 counts as 3.5, not 3.4999….
		const steps = Math.round(Number(((clamped - anchor) / step).toFixed(9)));
		const snapped = anchor + steps * step;
		// Round to the step's precision so 0.1 + 0.2 lands on 0.3.
		return Number(clamp(snapped, lower, upper).toFixed(decimals));
	};

	const controlled = valueProp !== undefined;
	const [internalValue, setInternalValue] = useState(() => snap(defaultValue));
	const value = controlled ? snap(valueProp) : internalValue;

	// Digits roll in the direction the value moved.

	if (shown.value !== value) {
		setShown({ value, trend: value > shown.value ? 1 : -1 });
	}

	const [holding, setHolding] = useState<Direction | null>(null);
	const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState("");

		() => new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, format),
		[locale, format],
	);
	const separators = useMemo(() => getSeparators(locale), [locale]);
	const formatValue = (next: number) => formatter.format(next);
	const valueText = formatValue(value);

		draft === null ? null : parseNumber(draft, separators, percent);
	const invalid =
		draft !== null &&
		draft.trim() !== "" &&
		draftValue !== null &&
		(Number.isNaN(draftValue) || snap(draftValue) !== draftValue);

	const { trigger: haptic } = useWebHaptics();
	const {
		click: playClick,
		pop: playPop,
		toggle: playToggle,
		warning: playWarning,
	} = useTiks({
		// Sound stays on under reduced motion; only movement is reduced.
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});

	const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
	const [valueScope, animateValue] = useAnimate<HTMLDivElement>();

		[-1]: null,
	});

		[-1]: null,
	});

	const draftRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
	const lastEmittedRef = useRef(value);
	const lastCueAtRef = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
	const announcedRef = useRef(valueText);
	const pressRef = useRef(false);
	const pressedButtonRef = useRef<Direction | null>(null);

		startedAt: number;
		repeats: number;
		accelerated: boolean;
		timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;

	});

		setDraftState(next);

		lastCueAtRef.current = now;

			if (haptics) void haptic("light");
		} else {
			if (sound) playClick();
			if (haptics) void haptic("selection");
		}

		if (sound) playWarning();
		if (haptics) void haptic("warning");
	};

		lastCueAtRef.current = performance.now();
		if (sound) playPop();
		if (haptics) void haptic("rigid");
		if (shouldReduceMotion || !valueScope.current) return;
		const offsets = [0, 4, -3, 0].map(
			(offset) => offset * (horizontal ? direction : -direction),
		);
		void animateValue(
			valueScope.current,
			horizontal ? { x: offsets } : { y: offsets },
			{ duration: 0.22, ease: "easeOut" },
		);
	};

		lastEmittedRef.current = next;

		onValueChange?.(next);

		setDraft(null);

		const parsed = parseNumber(text, separators, percent);
		if (Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
			warn();
			return current;
		}
		const next = snap(parsed);
		if (next !== parsed) warn();
		if (next !== current) {
			emit(next);
			onValueCommit?.(next);
		}
		return next;

		multiplier = 1,
		kind: StepKind = "step",

		const next = snap(current + direction * step * multiplier);
		if (next === current) return "blocked";
		emit(next);

		if (atLimit) {

	};

	};

			return;
		}

			if (draftRef.current === null) return;
			event.preventDefault();
			commitDraft();
			return;
		}
		if (inactive) return;
		let direction: Direction | null = null;
		let multiplier = 1;
		switch (event.key) {
			case "ArrowUp":
				direction = 1;
				multiplier = event.shiftKey ? largeStep : 1;
				break;
			case "ArrowDown":
				direction = -1;
				multiplier = event.shiftKey ? largeStep : 1;
				break;
			case "PageUp":
				direction = 1;
				multiplier = largeStep;
				break;
			case "PageDown":
				direction = -1;
				multiplier = largeStep;
				break;
			case "Home":
				if (!Number.isFinite(lower)) return;
				event.preventDefault();
				jumpTo(lower);
				return;
			case "End":
				if (!Number.isFinite(upper)) return;
				event.preventDefault();
				jumpTo(upper);
				return;
			default:
				return;
		}
		event.preventDefault();
		if (stepBy(direction, multiplier) !== "blocked") {
			onValueCommit?.(valueRef.current);
		}
	};

	const handlePaste = (event: ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
		if (inactive) return;
		event.preventDefault();
		const input = event.currentTarget;
		const pasted = normalizeNumber(
			event.clipboardData.getData("text"),
			separators,
		).replace(".", separators.decimal);
		const text = input.value;
		const start = input.selectionStart ?? text.length;
		const end = input.selectionEnd ?? text.length;
		setDraft(text.slice(0, start) + pasted + text.slice(end));
	};

	useEffect(() => {
		if (holdRef.current && valueProp !== lastEmittedRef.current) {
			endPressRef.current();
		}
	}, [valueProp]);

	useEffect(() => {
		if (inactive) endPressRef.current();
	}, [inactive]);

	// Releasing outside the window never reaches the button.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (holding === null) return;
		const end = () => endPressRef.current();
		window.addEventListener("blur", end);
		return () => window.removeEventListener("blur", end);
	}, [holding]);

	useEffect(
		() => () => {
			if (holdRef.current) clearTimeout(holdRef.current.timer);
		},
		[],
	);

	// Announce once the value settles, not on every repeat. A focused
	// spinbutton already reads its own changes, so skip those.

		if (valueText === announcedRef.current) return;
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			announcedRef.current = valueText;
			if (document.activeElement !== inputRef.current) {
				setAnnouncement(valueText);
			}
		}, ANNOUNCE_DELAY);
		return () => clearTimeout(timer);
	}, [valueText]);

	useEffect(() => {
		const input = inputRef.current;
		if (!input || !wheel || inactive) return;
		let accumulated = 0;
		const onWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
			if (document.activeElement !== input || event.deltaY === 0) return;
			event.preventDefault();
			let steps = 0;
			if (event.deltaMode !== 0 || Math.abs(event.deltaY) >= WHEEL_STEP_PX) {
				// One notch, one step.
				steps = -Math.sign(event.deltaY);
				accumulated = 0;
			} else {
				accumulated += event.deltaY;
				steps = -Math.trunc(accumulated / WHEEL_STEP_PX);
				accumulated += steps * WHEEL_STEP_PX;
			}
			if (steps !== 0) wheelStepRef.current(steps);
		};
		input.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { passive: false });
		return () => input.removeEventListener("wheel", onWheel);
	}, [wheel, inactive]);

	const atMax = value >= upper;
	const typing = draft !== null;
	const sizeStyle = sizes[size];
	const variantStyle = variants[variant];
	const widthChars =
		Math.max(
			2,
			...[lower, upper, value]
				.filter(Number.isFinite)
				.map((bound) => formatValue(bound).length),
		) + 1;
	const inputMode =
		lower < 0 ? "text" : decimals > 0 && !percent ? "decimal" : "numeric";

	const renderButton = (direction: Direction) => {
		const increase = direction === 1;
		const blocked = increase ? atMax : atMin;
		const Icon = horizontal
			? increase
				? Plus
				: Minus

				? ChevronUp
				: ChevronDown;

			<button
				ref={(node) => {
					buttonRefs.current[direction] = node;
				}}
				type="button"
				tabIndex={-1}
				aria-label={`${increase ? "Increase" : "Decrease"} ${label}`}
				aria-controls={inputId}
				disabled={inactive || blocked}
				data-slot={`number-stepper-${increase ? "increment" : "decrement"}`}
				data-holding={holding === direction || undefined}
				onPointerDown={(event) => handlePointerDown(direction, event)}
				onPointerUp={endPress}
				onPointerLeave={endPress}
				onPointerCancel={endPress}
				onClick={(event) => handleClick(direction, event)}
				// Keep focus (and any draft) in the input.
				onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
				onContextMenu={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
				className={cn(
					"relative inline-flex pointer-coarse:min-h-11 pointer-coarse:min-w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer touch-manipulation select-none items-center justify-center outline-none transition-[opacity,color,background-color] duration-150 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40",
					horizontal
						? sizeStyle.button[variant]
						: cn("w-full", sizeStyle.verticalButton),
					sizeStyle.icon,
					variantStyle.button,
				)}
			>
				<Icon aria-hidden />
				<span
					ref={(node) => {
						ringRefs.current[direction] = node;
					}}
					aria-hidden
					data-slot="number-stepper-ring"
					className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] opacity-0 ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-1 ring-offset-background"
				/>
			</button>
		);
	};

	return (
		<div
			dir="ltr"
			data-slot="number-stepper"
			data-variant={variant}
			data-size={size}
			data-orientation={orientation}
			data-state={holding !== null ? "holding" : typing ? "typing" : "idle"}
			data-bound={atMin ? "min" : atMax ? "max" : undefined}
			data-invalid={invalid || undefined}
			data-disabled={disabled || undefined}
			data-readonly={readOnly || undefined}
			className={cn(
				"inline-flex w-fit items-center font-medium tabular-nums data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:opacity-50",
				horizontal ? "flex-row gap-1" : "min-w-12 flex-col gap-0.5",
				variant === "outline" && (horizontal ? "px-1" : "py-1"),
				sizeStyle.root,
				variantStyle.root,
				className,
			)}
		>
			{renderButton(horizontal ? -1 : 1)}
			<motion.div
				ref={valueScope}
				data-slot="number-stepper-value"
				className="grid place-items-center"
			>
				<input
					ref={inputRef}
					id={inputId}
					type="text"
					role="spinbutton"
					inputMode={inputMode}
					autoComplete="off"
					autoCorrect="off"
					spellCheck={false}
					aria-label={label}
					aria-valuenow={value}
					aria-valuemin={Number.isFinite(lower) ? lower : undefined}
					aria-valuemax={Number.isFinite(upper) ? upper : undefined}
					aria-valuetext={valueText}
					aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
					disabled={disabled}
					readOnly={readOnly}
					value={draft ?? valueText}
					onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
					// Show the real text where the click lands, ready to edit.
					onPointerDown={() => {
						if (!inactive && draftRef.current === null) setDraft(valueText);
					}}
					onBlur={commitDraft}
					onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
					onPaste={handlePaste}
					style={{ width: `${widthChars}ch` }}
					className={cn(
						"col-start-1 row-start-1 h-full min-w-0 bg-transparent px-0.5 text-center outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed aria-invalid:text-destructive",
						!horizontal && "py-0.5",
						// While NumberFlow shows the value, the input stays invisible.
						!typing &&
							"text-transparent caret-transparent selection:bg-transparent",
						variantStyle.input,
					)}
				/>
				{typing ? null : (
					<NumberFlow
						aria-hidden
						value={value}
						locales={locale}
						format={format as Format | undefined}
						trend={shown.trend}
						animated={!shouldReduceMotion}
						respectMotionPreference={false}
						transformTiming={digitTiming}
						spinTiming={digitTiming}
						className="pointer-events-none col-start-1 row-start-1"
					/>
				)}
			</motion.div>
			{renderButton(horizontal ? 1 : -1)}
			{name ? (
				<input type="hidden" name={name} value={value} disabled={disabled} />
			) : null}
			<span aria-live="polite" aria-atomic className="sr-only">
				{announcement}
			</span>
		</div>
	);
}

const fadeTransition = { duration: 0.12, ease: "easeOut" } as const;

/** Fastest release, in px/s, so one jumpy pointer event can't fling the row. */
